Each file in photos by date or videos by date SHALL lie in the folder of its recorded time's day, directly under its
band; prep moves one that does not into it — or, with no recorded time, into missing metadata.
RUL-by_date_in_day_folder.title: A dated file lies in its day folder

RUL-cache_schema_not_migrated.content: Prep SHALL stop on a workspace database whose recorded schema is not the one it uses, migrating none.
RUL-cache_schema_not_migrated.title: A database of another schema is not migrated

RUL-camera_classes_not_derivation.content:
Of camera grouping, the configuration SHALL set only which camera groups are phones and which have fixed clocks — never
how a group is derived, nor the version of that derivation.
RUL-camera_classes_not_derivation.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-camera_classes_not_derivation.title: The user classifies camera groups; how they are derived is fixed

RUL-camera_group_derivation_versioned.content:
How camera groups are derived SHALL carry a version taking part in the checks of freshness and of dependencies, so that
a change to the derivation is detected and old and new groups are never silently mixed.
RUL-camera_group_derivation_versioned.title: The derivation carries a version

RUL-carry_forward_by_copy.content:
To carry an earlier phase's record forward, a phase SHALL copy it to a record of its own and extend the copy — leaving
the earlier one untouched, and never deriving an earlier phase's history again.
RUL-carry_forward_by_copy.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-carry_forward_by_copy.title: An earlier record is carried forward by copying it

RUL-cause_locatable.content:
Every change a phase executes SHALL be traceable in the records, from the decision and the inputs it was made from,
through the plan, to the record of what ran — so a wrong result points at a recorded choice.
RUL-cause_locatable.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-cause_locatable.title: The cause of every change can be found

RUL-checked_every_run.content: A value SHALL be checked every time a run uses it, never taken as valid because an earlier run found it so.
RUL-checked_every_run.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_every_run.title: A value is checked each time it is used

RUL-checked_extension_lists.content:
Each class's list of extensions SHALL be non-empty, and each extension in it lowercase, without its dot, and holding no
separator or space.
RUL-checked_extension_lists.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_extension_lists.title: The extension lists are checked

RUL-checked_filename_format.content:
The filename format SHALL make a part of a name that is never empty and is safe on the filesystem: no path separator
and no character a filename may not hold.
RUL-checked_filename_format.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_filename_format.title: The filename format makes a safe name

RUL-checked_folder_names.content:
The managed folders' names SHALL each be one part of a path, not hidden, all different, and none the name of the control
records' place or of the quarantine.
RUL-checked_folder_names.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_folder_names.title: The managed folders' names are checked

RUL-checked_numbers.content:
A number the configuration sets — a threshold, a distance, a duration — SHALL be of the right kind and within
a sane range: a duration or a distance is never negative.
RUL-checked_numbers.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_numbers.title: A number is of the right kind and in range

RUL-checked_paths.content:
A path the configuration names SHALL be neither empty nor blank, hold no character the platform forbids, and stay where
it must: the tracks' place outside the managed folders, the library's an existing folder that neither lies inside the workspace nor holds it.
RUL-checked_paths.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_paths.title: A configured path is checked

RUL-checked_positions_and_times.content:
A position or a clock offset the user writes SHALL be well formed: a position two numbers — latitude −90 to 90,
longitude −180 to 180, both or neither; a clock offset a whole number of seconds, of any size.
RUL-checked_positions_and_times.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_positions_and_times.title: A position and a clock offset are well formed

RUL-checked_shapes.content:
A yes-or-no SHALL be a yes or a no, a value from a fixed set — a device group's class among them — one of that set, and
a decision's structure whole: a decision whose structure is broken is an error, never ignored.
RUL-checked_shapes.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_shapes.title: A choice is one of its choices, and a decision has its shape

RUL-checked_snapshot_names.content:
The settings a snapshot's name is made from SHALL be checked to make a valid snapshot name before any snapshot is
attempted.
RUL-checked_snapshot_names.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_snapshot_names.title: A snapshot's name is checked before any snapshot

RUL-checked_timezones.content: A timezone the user writes SHALL be a real zone that resolves, never an arbitrary string.
RUL-checked_timezones.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_timezones.title: A timezone is a real zone

RUL-chosen_group_is_anchored.content:
A clock offset the user sets that the camera's own GPS positions support SHALL count as anchored by them, as an
accepted proposal does — never asked to be checked against the tracks again.
RUL-chosen_group_is_anchored.section_name: 19. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 19. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-chosen_group_is_anchored.title: An offset the camera's GPS supports is anchored, however chosen

RUL-collision_by_content.content: Where an incoming photo's place in the library is taken, merge SHALL compare the two by fingerprint.
RUL-collision_by_content.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-collision_by_content.title: A taken place is settled by content

RUL-collision_different_content.content:
A taken place holding different content SHALL mean two photos share a name: the incoming one is placed under a
differentiating name.
RUL-collision_different_content.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-collision_different_content.title: Different content is placed under a differentiating name

RUL-collision_same_content.content:
A taken place holding the same content SHALL mean the photo is already in the library: nothing is written there, and the
workspace's copy is removed.
RUL-collision_same_content.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-collision_same_content.title: The same content is already in the library

RUL-config_archived.content: The configuration SHALL be part of the archival record the workspace leaves behind.
RUL-config_archived.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_archived.title: The configuration is part of the permanent record

RUL-config_authoritative.content:
Once a workspace's configuration exists, it SHALL govern every run in that workspace, whatever the seed defaults later
become — the defaults serving only to seed a new workspace.
RUL-config_authoritative.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_authoritative.title: The workspace's configuration governs it, not the defaults

RUL-config_complete.content: A configuration that lacks a setting SHALL stop the run, naming the setting — never filled from the program's defaults.
RUL-config_complete.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_complete.title: A configuration missing a setting stops the run

RUL-config_digest_recorded.content: A digest of the configuration's whole content SHALL be recorded for integrity.
RUL-config_digest_recorded.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_digest_recorded.title: A digest of the whole configuration is recorded

RUL-config_in_dependencies.content:
The configuration SHALL be a dependency of what is derived under it, like every other artifact, so that a change to it
never changes a run without being detected.
RUL-config_in_dependencies.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_in_dependencies.title: The configuration is a dependency of what is made under it

RUL-config_lists_extensions.content: The configuration SHALL list which extensions are images, raw files and videos, never the classes themselves.
RUL-config_lists_extensions.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_lists_extensions.title: The configuration lists the extensions, not the classes

RUL-config_never_media.content:
No phase SHALL treat the configuration as media — inventorying or organizing it, or folding it into what identifies the
media.
RUL-config_never_media.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_never_media.title: The configuration is never media

RUL-config_no_unknown_settings.content: A configuration holding a setting cartographer does not know SHALL stop the run, naming the setting.
RUL-config_no_unknown_settings.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_no_unknown_settings.title: A configuration holding an unknown setting stops the run

RUL-config_seeded_once.content:
A prep run SHALL create the configuration from the seed defaults when it finds none, and only then: a configuration it
finds, it uses as it is.
RUL-config_seeded_once.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_seeded_once.title: Prep seeds the configuration once

RUL-config_validated_before_use.content:
Every value of the configuration that comes from the user SHALL be validated before it is used, as part of reading the
configuration — never as a separate, optional pass.
RUL-config_validated_before_use.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_validated_before_use.title: Every value the user supplies is checked before use

RUL-config_writers.content:
The configuration SHALL be written only when prep seeds it, when the user edits it by hand, and by the library setup
below — never by geotag, and never by merge's planning, dry run or execution.
RUL-config_writers.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_writers.title: Who writes the configuration

RUL-confirmation_holds_for_its_offset.content: A confirmation SHALL hold only for the offset it confirmed; a changed offset is asked about again.
RUL-confirmation_holds_for_its_offset.title: A confirmation holds for the offset it confirmed

RUL-container_never_waits.content: A container destination's decisions SHALL never wait for the user.
RUL-container_never_waits.title: A container destination never waits for the user

RUL-content_changed_write_held.content:
A write after which a photo's decoded content differs SHALL NOT count as done — its rename held back with it — until
the user accepts the new content.
RUL-content_changed_write_held.title: A write that changes the picture is held back

RUL-control_directory_fixed.content:
Where a workspace keeps its control records — its configuration among them — SHALL be fixed, the same in every
workspace, no setting moving it.
RUL-control_directory_fixed.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-control_directory_fixed.title: Where the control records live is fixed

RUL-control_records_never_media.content:
The control records' place SHALL be left out of every inventory of media as a whole — not file by file — so that no
phase takes a control record for media.
RUL-control_records_never_media.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-control_records_never_media.title: The control records' place is never searched for media

RUL-control_records_together.content:
Every control record SHALL be kept in the workspace's one place for them, none among the media or at the workspace's top
level.
RUL-control_records_together.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-control_records_together.title: The control records are kept together, apart from the media

RUL-copy_kept_by_folder.content:
The copy prep keeps SHALL be the one first in this order of the folders the copies lie in when planned — photos by
destination, photos by date, videos by date, redundant JPEGs, missing metadata, the inbox — and, among copies in one
folder, the first by path.
RUL-copy_kept_by_folder.title: The copy kept is the best filed

RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.content: A result that is costly to rebuild SHALL be made stale only by the areas it depends on.
RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.title: Costly results survive edits they do not depend on

RUL-crash_temps_cleared.content:
Merge SHALL clear, as its execution starts, the temporary copies an interrupted merge left in the folders it places
into, and record how many.
RUL-crash_temps_cleared.title: A temporary copy a crash left is cleared

RUL-cross_fs_all_or_nothing.content:
Where merge's placement into the library crosses filesystems and cannot be one operation, it SHALL be made equivalent:
the file copied under a temporary name beside its place, verified, and only then given its name, if that is still free —
so that an interruption leaves no file under that name, or the complete one, never part of one.
RUL-cross_fs_all_or_nothing.title: Across filesystems, a placement is still all or nothing

RUL-database_image_each_phase.content:
Each phase SHALL keep its database image, refreshed by each of its successful runs alone, and left untouched by every
other phase and by a run that does not succeed.
RUL-database_image_each_phase.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_image_each_phase.title: Each phase keeps an image of the database at its end

RUL-database_image_whole.content: A database image SHALL be a consistent state of the database, never a copy torn mid-transaction.
RUL-database_image_whole.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_image_whole.title: An image is whole

RUL-database_is_record.content:
The workspace database SHALL be kept with the control records and archived in the package, never discarded with the
workspace as a cache would be.
RUL-database_is_record.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_is_record.title: The database is part of the record

RUL-database_matches_files.content:
A prep execution SHALL leave the workspace database current: a row for each media file prep inventoried, describing the
file as it now is and where it now is, and no row for a file that is gone.
RUL-database_matches_files.title: The workspace database matches the files

RUL-database_over_memo.content:
Prep SHALL take a file's fingerprint and metadata from the plan memo only where the workspace database holds no row for
its path.
RUL-database_over_memo.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-database_over_memo.title: The database outranks the memo

RUL-database_regions_disjoint.content: Each phase SHALL write only its own part of the workspace database, no two phases writing the same rows.
RUL-database_regions_disjoint.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_regions_disjoint.title: Each phase writes only its own part of the database

RUL-day_offset_kept_for_later_photos.content:
A camera's clock offset for a day, once resolved, SHALL stay that day's offset for photos of that camera arriving
later — one found from its own GPS included, though the later photos bring no anchor.
RUL-day_offset_kept_for_later_photos.title: A camera's offset for a day holds for its later photos

RUL-decision_fields_laid_out.content: A phase SHALL create every field a decision needs, so the user fills in values, never structure.
RUL-decision_fields_laid_out.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-decision_fields_laid_out.title: The tool lays out every decision's fields

RUL-decision_kept.content:
A decision the user made SHALL be kept, by every phase and through every run, while what it decides about is
unchanged.
RUL-decision_kept.title: A decision is kept while its target is unchanged

RUL-decision_revisable.content:
A decision SHALL be revised by changing it in the record and running again, the change reaching everything that depends
on it: no change the tool makes is irreversible at the level of the decisions, and a wrong choice never needs the
mutated files repaired by hand.
RUL-decision_revisable.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-decision_revisable.title: A wrong decision is fixed in the record

RUL-decision_stage_writes_record.content: Each decision stage geotag reaches SHALL write its record, even when nothing in it needs the user.
RUL-decision_stage_writes_record.title: A decision stage reached writes its record

RUL-development_after_merge.content:
Development SHALL happen in the library, after merge: a development subfolder anywhere in photos by destination — even
an empty one — stops geotag's planning, execution and finalize, and merge.
RUL-development_after_merge.title: Development happens in the library, after merge

RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.content:
A dry run SHALL validate the saved plan that execution would carry out, and report on that plan — never on a separate
simulation.
RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.title: A dry run summarises the real plan

RUL-dump_folder_named_as_managed.content:
Initializing, prep SHALL take a folder at the top level named as a managed folder for that managed folder, never moving
it into the inbox.
RUL-dump_folder_named_as_managed.section_name: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-dump_folder_named_as_managed.title: A dump folder named as a managed folder is that folder

RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.content:
Hidden files that arrive in a dump area — the workspace's top level on the run that initializes it, or the inbox — SHALL
be moved to the recoverable quarantine, not merely left out.
RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.title: Hidden files in a dump are quarantined

RUL-duplicate_recorded_with_kept.content: Prep SHALL record each duplicate it quarantines with the copy it kept, in the quarantine manifest and the handoff.
RUL-duplicate_recorded_with_kept.section_name: 11. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 11. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-duplicate_recorded_with_kept.title: A duplicate is recorded with the copy kept

RUL-duplicate_set_aside_as_found.content:
Prep SHALL quarantine a duplicate from the place and under the name it had when planned, no other stage of the plan
moving or renaming it first.
RUL-duplicate_set_aside_as_found.title: A duplicate is set aside as it was found

RUL-duplicates_quarantined.content:
Of the media files prep inventories that share one fingerprint and one media class, prep SHALL keep one and quarantine
every other copy outside photos by destination.
RUL-duplicates_quarantined.title: Of identical media, one copy is kept

RUL-editor_refuses_sealed.content: The decision editor SHALL neither open a sealed workspace nor save into it.
RUL-editor_refuses_sealed.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-editor_refuses_sealed.title: The decision editor refuses a sealed workspace

RUL-emptied_folders_removed.content:
Prep SHALL remove a folder its plan leaves empty — in the inbox or a by-date folder, or a dump's folder on the first run
— only as a planned operation, and only while the folder is empty.
RUL-emptied_folders_removed.title: A folder left empty is removed as planned

RUL-empty_inbox_normal.content: An empty inbox SHALL be normal — the steady state, not a missing folder.
RUL-empty_inbox_normal.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-empty_inbox_normal.title: An empty inbox is normal

RUL-engine_change_is_checked.content:
A photo's fingerprint taken under another ImageMagick version SHALL be taken again before a phase relies on it, a new
value read as the same photo's — its records following it there, or the phase stopping on the photo where they cannot —
never, for a changed version alone, as a different photo's.
RUL-engine_change_is_checked.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-engine_change_is_checked.title: Another ImageMagick is a reason to check a fingerprint

RUL-every_change_journaled.content: Every change an execution makes to a media file SHALL be recorded in that run's journal.
RUL-every_change_journaled.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-every_change_journaled.title: Every change is journaled

RUL-every_command_locks.content: Every run, and every change to the workspace, SHALL hold the workspace's lock.
RUL-every_command_locks.title: Every run, and every change, takes the lock

RUL-evidence_before_quarantine.content:
Prep SHALL record why it quarantines a file — its path, the copy kept and the shared fingerprint — before it moves the
file into the quarantine.
RUL-evidence_before_quarantine.title: A duplicate's evidence is recorded before it is moved

RUL-execution_jobs_change_nothing.content:
An execution SHALL change the same files in the same way, and record the same, whatever number of jobs it runs with —
the job count and the run's times in its run metadata the only difference.
RUL-execution_jobs_change_nothing.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-execution_jobs_change_nothing.title: The job count changes nothing an execution does

RUL-execution_only_the_plan.content: Execution SHALL carry out only the operations its plan records, re-deriving no decision.
RUL-execution_only_the_plan.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-execution_only_the_plan.title: Execution carries out the plan, and only the plan

RUL-extension_matched_ignoring_case.content: A file's extension SHALL be matched to the configuration's lists ignoring case.
RUL-extension_matched_ignoring_case.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-extension_matched_ignoring_case.title: An extension is matched ignoring case

RUL-extension_one_class.content: An extension SHALL be in exactly one class of media.
RUL-extension_one_class.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-extension_one_class.title: Each extension is one class of media

RUL-failed_fingerprint_blocks.content: A media file outside photos by destination whose fingerprint failed SHALL block prep's plan.
RUL-failed_fingerprint_blocks.section_name: 11. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 11. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-failed_fingerprint_blocks.title: A failed fingerprint outside photos by destination blocks

RUL-failed_fingerprint_no_duplicate.content: A media file whose fingerprint failed SHALL be found the duplicate of no file, and no file its duplicate.
RUL-failed_fingerprint_no_duplicate.section_name: 11. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 11. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-failed_fingerprint_no_duplicate.title: A failed fingerprint matches nothing

RUL-failed_fingerprint_retried.content: Prep SHALL take a media file's fingerprint again at every run while it has failed.
RUL-failed_fingerprint_retried.section_name: 11. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 11. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-failed_fingerprint_retried.title: A failed fingerprint is taken again

RUL-failed_operation_clean.content: An operation that cannot complete SHALL leave its file as it was before it.
RUL-failed_operation_clean.title: A failed operation leaves its file as it was

RUL-failure_never_done.content: An operation that cannot complete SHALL never be recorded as done, so that a re-run does it again.
RUL-failure_never_done.title: A failed operation is never recorded as done

RUL-failure_recorded.content: The failure of an operation that cannot complete SHALL be recorded.
RUL-failure_recorded.title: A failed operation's failure is recorded

RUL-fallback_from_nearest.content:
A destination's folder-fallback proposal SHALL be the fallback in effect at the nearest destination it lies in that
has one.
RUL-fallback_from_nearest.title: A destination's fallback is the nearest one it lies in

RUL-fallback_optional.content:
A destination SHALL never wait on its folder fallback: without one, its photos the tracks cannot place each ask on
their own.
RUL-fallback_optional.title: No destination waits on its fallback

RUL-filed_file_stays.content:
A media file outside the inbox SHALL stay in the folder it is in, unless prep sets it aside as a duplicate or it is a
dated file outside its day folder.
RUL-filed_file_stays.title: A filed media file stays in its folder

RUL-filesystem_agnostic.content:
Nothing in cartographer but the snapshot SHALL depend on a particular filesystem's features, so that cartographer runs
fully on a filesystem that has none.
RUL-filesystem_agnostic.omit_reason: a design constraint over the whole code; the gap audit (backlog item 2) checks it
RUL-filesystem_agnostic.title: Only the snapshot depends on the filesystem

RUL-finalize_explicit.content: Finalize SHALL be a command of its own, never a side effect of geotag's execution.
RUL-finalize_explicit.title: Finalize is its own command

RUL-finalize_non_destructive.content:
Finalize SHALL change nothing in the workspace's media, its other records or the library, only reading the record that
already stands at the end of geotag and writing the package from it.
RUL-finalize_non_destructive.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-finalize_non_destructive.title: Finalize only reads and records

RUL-finalize_reads_database.content: Finalize SHALL only read the workspace database.
RUL-finalize_reads_database.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-finalize_reads_database.title: Finalize only reads the database

RUL-finalize_requires_success.content: Finalize SHALL refuse unless geotag's current plan was executed successfully and still holds.
RUL-finalize_requires_success.title: Finalize packages only an execution that succeeded and still holds

RUL-fingerprint_method_matches.content:
Prep SHALL reuse a cached fingerprint only when the method that took it is the one now in use for the file's class,
taking again one that does not record its method in full.
RUL-fingerprint_method_matches.title: A fingerprint is reused only from the method in use

RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.content: A media file's fingerprint SHALL stay the same when the pipeline rewrites its metadata or its position, or renames it.
RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.title: A fingerprint survives what the pipeline does to a file

RUL-fingerprint_taken_afresh.content:
Prep SHALL fingerprint a media file afresh when the workspace database holds no fingerprint for it at its path, or holds
one taken when the file had another size or modification time.
RUL-fingerprint_taken_afresh.title: A new or changed file is fingerprinted afresh

RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.content:
On a workspace not yet initialized, the files and folders at the top level SHALL be the first dump, and start
initialization — a symbolic link there still blocking, as everywhere.
RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.title: A new workspace's first dump is at its top level

RUL-folder_found_by_role.content: Every phase SHALL find a managed folder by its role, never by its name.
RUL-folder_found_by_role.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-folder_found_by_role.title: A managed folder is found by its role

RUL-folder_names_not_roles.content: The configuration SHALL set the managed folders' names, never their roles or the structure they form.
RUL-folder_names_not_roles.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-folder_names_not_roles.title: The user names the folders; their roles are fixed

RUL-format_fixed_once_named.content: Once prep has named a workspace's files in a format, a change to the format SHALL stop every phase.
RUL-format_fixed_once_named.title: The format is fixed once files are named in it

RUL-geotag_changes_only_by_dest.content: Geotag SHALL change only the photos in photos by destination — never a video, and never a file in any other folder.
RUL-geotag_changes_only_by_dest.title: Geotag changes only the photos sorted into destinations

RUL-geotag_execution_resumable.content:
A geotag execution interrupted SHALL be finished by running it again, which applies only what is outstanding — a
fully applied plan changing nothing, and an edit made to a photo since the plan never written over.
RUL-geotag_execution_resumable.title: An interrupted execution is finished by running it again

RUL-geotag_gates.content:
Geotag SHALL proceed when, and only when, the workspace now satisfies its gates: photos by date holds no photo; photos
by destination holds only photos and no development subfolder; prep has recorded every photo in it; and the inbox is
empty — whether, or how often, prep, the sort or geotag ran before not bearing on it, so the user may run any number of
prep and sort cycles before geotagging.
RUL-geotag_gates.title: Geotag's gates are the present state, not its history

RUL-geotag_merge_check_top_level_links.content:
Geotag and merge SHALL check the top level for links themselves, and consume only a handoff prep built with no link
present.
RUL-geotag_merge_check_top_level_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-geotag_merge_check_top_level_links.title: Geotag and merge check the top level for links

RUL-geotag_name_final.content:
Geotag SHALL recompute a file's name from its corrected local time at the destination — its resolved true time, in the
destination's civil timezone — and rename it to that final name.
RUL-geotag_name_final.title: Geotag's name is final

RUL-geotag_plan_carries_every_dependency.content:
Geotag's executable plan SHALL carry every dependency it was made from itself — each decision record, the handoff, the
tracks, the configuration, the code and each photo's precondition — never relying on a decision record's own
dependencies to vouch for what came before it.
RUL-geotag_plan_carries_every_dependency.title: The executable plan carries every dependency itself

RUL-geotag_plans_on_current_record.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT plan while a photo prep recorded in photos by destination is gone, or differs in size or modification
time from prep's record.
RUL-geotag_plans_on_current_record.title: Geotag plans only on a record that still holds

RUL-geotag_rerun_keeps_settled.content:
A geotag re-run SHALL recognise in each file what an earlier run wrote there — never correcting again a time geotag
corrected, and deriving again and replacing a position geotag wrote, never keeping it as the file's own. The user's
decisions, and files already right, it keeps as every run does.
RUL-geotag_rerun_keeps_settled.title: A re-run changes nothing already settled

RUL-geotag_rerunnable.content:
Geotag SHALL be re-runnable any number of times — after a successful execution too — for as long as the workspace has
not been merged.
RUL-geotag_rerunnable.title: Geotag may be re-run until merge

RUL-geotag_reuses_camera_group.content: Geotag SHALL use the camera group prep derived, never deriving a file's identity again.
RUL-geotag_reuses_camera_group.title: Geotag reuses prep's camera group

RUL-grouping_facts_reported.content:
Prep's handoff SHALL report, for each camera group and each folder of photos by destination, facts of the files in it —
their count, their time range, how many carry a GPS position — inferring nothing from them.
RUL-grouping_facts_reported.section_name: 12. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 12. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-grouping_facts_reported.title: The handoff reports what the groups hold

RUL-handoff_describes_workspace.content:
Prep's handoff SHALL describe the workspace as prep leaves it: every media file with its place, its fingerprint's state
and its metadata; the camera groups and the destination folders; the folders prep organizes and which of them it may
change; and what the handoff was made from.
RUL-handoff_describes_workspace.title: The handoff describes the workspace geotag works on

RUL-handoff_deterministic.content:
Prep's handoff SHALL hold the same content for the same workspace state, whatever run wrote it — what describes the run
kept apart from it.
RUL-handoff_deterministic.title: One workspace state, one handoff content

RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.content:
Geotag SHALL verify prep's handoff before using it by the fingerprint of its content — recomputed, and compared with
the one its dependencies recorded — never by the file's exact bytes.
RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.title: Geotag verifies the handoff by its content

RUL-hash_detects_any_change.content: A record's hash SHALL change on any change to its bytes.
RUL-hash_detects_any_change.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-hash_detects_any_change.title: A hash changes with any byte

RUL-hash_is_the_dependency_check.content: A record SHALL be checked as a dependency by its hash — prep's handoff excepted, which is checked by its content.
RUL-hash_is_the_dependency_check.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-hash_is_the_dependency_check.title: A record is checked as a dependency by its hash

RUL-history_retained.content:
The records the log is made from SHALL be kept across runs in enough detail to rebuild every photo's history through
each phase — each step, the decision and inputs behind it, and the run that made it — never only the last run's.
Anything beyond that MAY be pruned.
RUL-history_retained.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-history_retained.title: History is kept across runs, as much as the log needs

RUL-image_capture_atomic.content: An interrupted capture of a database image SHALL leave the earlier image or the new one, whole.
RUL-image_capture_atomic.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-image_capture_atomic.title: An interrupted capture leaves an image whole

RUL-image_never_working_data.content: A database image SHALL never be read back as working data.
RUL-image_never_working_data.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-image_never_working_data.title: A database image is never read back as working data

RUL-images_archived.content: Every database image present SHALL be archived in the package.
RUL-images_archived.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-images_archived.title: Every database image is archived

RUL-inbox_kept_as_dumped.content:
Prep SHALL move no file from one place in the inbox to another: a dump's folders stay as they arrived until each file
leaves the inbox.
RUL-inbox_kept_as_dumped.title: A dump keeps its folders in the inbox

RUL-inbox_non_media_to_strays.content:
Prep SHALL move each file of no media class in the inbox into the strays folder's subfolder for the run, at its place
under the inbox and with its name unchanged.
RUL-inbox_non_media_to_strays.title: Non-media leaves the inbox for the strays folder, as it came

RUL-indistinct_visits_wait.content: Where a camera's photos support two visits equally, its clock offset SHALL NOT take effect without the user's answer.
RUL-indistinct_visits_wait.section_name: 19. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 19. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-indistinct_visits_wait.title: Visits the photos cannot tell apart wait for the user

RUL-init_moves_dump_to_inbox.content:
Initializing a workspace, prep SHALL move every entry at its top level that is not a managed folder or the control
records' place — files and whole folders alike, their structure kept — into the inbox.
RUL-init_moves_dump_to_inbox.section_name: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-init_moves_dump_to_inbox.title: Initializing, prep moves the dump into the inbox

RUL-init_taken_up_again.content:
A run that finds a workspace not marked initialized SHALL initialize it, keeping what an interrupted initialization
already did: the folders it made, and the dump already in the inbox.
RUL-init_taken_up_again.section_name: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-init_taken_up_again.title: An interrupted initialization is taken up again

RUL-initialized_marked_last.content:
Prep SHALL mark a workspace initialized only once its initializing run has succeeded, every managed folder and the
control records' place in it.
RUL-initialized_marked_last.section_name: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-initialized_marked_last.title: A workspace is marked initialized last

RUL-invalid_decision_kept.content:
A decision found invalid SHALL be kept exactly as the user wrote it, and reported as needing correction — never erased
or rewritten.
RUL-invalid_decision_kept.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_decision_kept.title: An invalid decision is kept, and marked

RUL-invalid_value_located.content:
The report of an invalid value SHALL name the record and the field it was written in — for a decision, also the
destination, the camera group or the file it is about.
RUL-invalid_value_located.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_value_located.title: An invalid value is named where it was written

RUL-invalid_value_never_repaired.content: A value SHALL be used as written or not at all: never repaired.
RUL-invalid_value_never_repaired.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_value_never_repaired.title: An invalid value is never repaired

RUL-invalid_value_stops.content: A value found invalid SHALL stop the phase as a stale dependency does, nothing made from it and nothing changed.
RUL-invalid_value_stops.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_value_stops.title: An invalid value stops the phase before it changes anything

RUL-jobs_change_nothing.content:
Prep's plan of a workspace SHALL be the same whatever number of jobs it runs with: the same operations, names and
fingerprints.
RUL-jobs_change_nothing.section_name: 17. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 17. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-jobs_change_nothing.title: The job count changes nothing planned

RUL-jobs_recorded_nowhere.content: The number of jobs SHALL be recorded in no plan, configuration or handoff.
RUL-jobs_recorded_nowhere.section_name: 17. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 17. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-jobs_recorded_nowhere.title: The job count is recorded nowhere

RUL-journal_never_torn.content: An interruption SHALL leave prep's journal as its last save left it, never part-written.
RUL-journal_never_torn.title: The journal is never left torn

RUL-known_when_classified.content:
A camera group SHALL be known when the configuration classes it as a phone or as a camera with a fixed clock, and
unknown otherwise.
RUL-known_when_classified.title: A camera group is known once it is classified

RUL-library_confirmed_before_lock.content:
Merge SHALL take the workspace's lock first, then check the library's place and its mark, and only then take the
library's lock, so that no lock is ever left in a folder that is not a library — a merge stopped at any of these steps
having changed nothing in the library.
RUL-library_confirmed_before_lock.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_confirmed_before_lock.title: The library is confirmed before it is locked

RUL-library_creates_only_placements.content:
Beyond its mark and its lock, merge SHALL create in the library only the photos it places, the folders they go into,
and, while a photo crosses filesystems, its temporary copy.
RUL-library_creates_only_placements.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_creates_only_placements.title: Merge creates in the library only what it places

RUL-library_file_read_once.content:
A library file's fingerprint SHALL be computed only when a collision needs it, and kept, so that a library file
unchanged since is never fingerprinted again in the workspace, in that run or a later one, while the way photos are
decoded is unchanged too — save for the one check before a photo is removed from the workspace.
RUL-library_file_read_once.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_file_read_once.title: A library file is read at most once while unchanged

RUL-library_file_rechecked_before_remova.content:
Before a photo is removed from the workspace because the library already holds it, the library file SHALL be
fingerprinted again, whatever is kept.
RUL-library_file_rechecked_before_remova.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_file_rechecked_before_remova.title: A library file is fingerprinted again before a photo it holds is removed

RUL-library_known_by_mark.content:
A folder SHALL be taken for a library by one mark in it and by nothing else, merge inspecting no structure of the
library, which has none of a workspace's folders, guard or lifecycle.
RUL-library_known_by_mark.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_known_by_mark.title: A library is known by its mark alone

RUL-library_lock.content:
Merge SHALL hold a lock on the library for its whole run, besides the workspace's lock and not instead of it, so that no
two merges write one library at once, even from different workspaces.
RUL-library_lock.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_lock.title: One merge at a time in a library

RUL-library_lock_fail_fast.content: A merge that finds the library locked SHALL stop at once, having changed nothing in the library.
RUL-library_lock_fail_fast.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_lock_fail_fast.title: A locked library is refused at once

RUL-library_lock_holds_only_holder.content: The library's lock SHALL hold nothing about the library but who holds it.
RUL-library_lock_holds_only_holder.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_lock_holds_only_holder.title: The library's lock holds only who holds it

RUL-library_lock_stale_recovered.content: A library lock left by a merge that died SHALL be recognisable as stale, and recoverable, as the workspace's lock is.
RUL-library_lock_stale_recovered.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_lock_stale_recovered.title: A dead merge's library lock is recoverable

RUL-library_mark_made_by_setup.content: Merge's library setup alone SHALL make the library's mark — once, making it again changing nothing.
RUL-library_mark_made_by_setup.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_mark_made_by_setup.title: Only the library setup makes the mark, once

RUL-library_mark_required.content: Merge's plan, dry run and execution SHALL only read the library's mark, and stop at once if it is absent.
RUL-library_mark_required.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_mark_required.title: Merge's plan, dry run and execution stop without the mark

RUL-library_mirrors_destinations.content:
Merge SHALL place each photo at the same path under the library as it holds under photos by destination — its folders
as the user built them, its name the one geotag gave it — the name an incoming photo is given on a collision the only
change.
RUL-library_mirrors_destinations.title: The library mirrors the destination tree

RUL-library_never_altered.content:
Merge SHALL never rename, overwrite, move, delete or change a file already in the library, an incoming photo whose place
is taken giving way instead.
RUL-library_never_altered.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_never_altered.title: Merge never alters the library

RUL-library_not_scanned.content:
Merge SHALL touch the library only at the places its photos go, and read a library file only when one is already there —
never scanning, indexing or de-duplicating the library.
RUL-library_not_scanned.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_not_scanned.title: Merge reads the library only where it places a photo

RUL-library_place_checked.content:
Merge SHALL check the library's configured place like every path the user writes, refusing it unless it is an existing
folder that neither lies inside the workspace nor holds it.
RUL-library_place_checked.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_place_checked.title: The library's place is checked

RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.content:
Merge's one-time library setup, run inside a workspace and given a library, MAY record in the configuration which
library this workspace merges into — that setting, and no other.
RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.title: The library setup records one setting

RUL-library_takes_many_workspaces.content: The library SHALL accept merges from many workspaces.
RUL-library_takes_many_workspaces.title: The library accepts merges from many workspaces

RUL-link_named.content: A phase a link blocks SHALL name the link, and produce no executable plan and no artifact after it.
RUL-link_named.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-link_named.title: A blocking link is named, and nothing is made after it

RUL-lock_before_reading.content:
A run SHALL hold the lock before it reads any of the workspace's content — before it plans, scans, fingerprints,
reads metadata, dry-runs or executes. Planning changes nothing but the fingerprints it keeps for later runs, and is
inside the lock all the same.
RUL-lock_before_reading.title: The lock comes before anything is read

RUL-lock_fail_fast.content:
A run that finds the workspace locked SHALL stop at once, never waiting for it, saying the workspace is locked by a run
in progress, having scanned, planned and changed nothing — and having produced no plan, no dry-run report and no
artifact.
RUL-lock_fail_fast.title: A locked workspace is refused at once

RUL-lock_released_on_any_end.content: A run SHALL release the lock when it ends, whether it succeeds or fails.
RUL-lock_released_on_any_end.title: The lock is released however the run ends

RUL-lock_through_the_run.content:
A run SHALL hold the lock until it ends — through planning, dry run, execution, and every record and artifact it writes
— and release it then, never letting it outlive the run: between runs, the workspace is unlocked.
RUL-lock_through_the_run.title: The lock lasts the whole run, and no longer

RUL-log_cites_decisions.content: A step that followed from a decision SHALL name that decision, so the why stands beside the what.
RUL-log_cites_decisions.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_cites_decisions.title: A step names the decision behind it

RUL-log_entry_grows.content:
A photo's entry in the log SHALL gather the steps of every phase it passes through and be whole through the latest of
them, each phase only appending its own steps, never rewriting an earlier one — so the latest phase's log is the full
record, and each earlier log stays its own phase's.
RUL-log_entry_grows.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_entry_grows.title: A photo's entry grows one phase at a time

RUL-log_follows_retaken_fingerprint.content:
A photo whose fingerprint is taken again with a new value SHALL keep its history in the log, under the new value, with a
step recording the change.
RUL-log_follows_retaken_fingerprint.title: A photo keeps its history when its fingerprint is taken again

RUL-log_human_readable.content:
The log SHALL be readable as it stands, with no separate report: stably ordered, with descriptive names, and values as a
person reads them — times, timezones and offsets.
RUL-log_human_readable.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_human_readable.title: The log reads as it stands

RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.content: The log SHALL key each photo's entry by its fingerprint and carry the chain of names and places it passed through.
RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.title: The log is keyed by fingerprint

RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.content:
A manual position applied, changed or withdrawn SHALL appear in the log with the position it replaced or restored, or
that there was none.
RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.title: A manual position's reversal is logged like its application

RUL-media_extension_lowercase.content: Each media file prep files, or finds outside the inbox, SHALL end with its extension in lowercase.
RUL-media_extension_lowercase.title: A media file's extension is lowercase

RUL-memo_entry_same_tests.content: Prep SHALL reuse an entry of the plan memo only when a row of the workspace database holding it would be reused.
RUL-memo_entry_same_tests.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-memo_entry_same_tests.title: A memo entry passes the database's tests

RUL-memo_never_changes_plan.content:
The plan prep makes SHALL be the same whatever the plan memo holds — entries reused, none, or a file that cannot be
read.
RUL-memo_never_changes_plan.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-memo_never_changes_plan.title: The memo never changes the plan

RUL-memo_proves_no_move.content: Prep SHALL recognize a moved file from the workspace database alone, never from the plan memo.
RUL-memo_proves_no_move.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-memo_proves_no_move.title: The memo proves no move

RUL-memo_tracks_workspace.content: The plan memo SHALL hold entries only for paths the latest plan read.
RUL-memo_tracks_workspace.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-memo_tracks_workspace.title: The memo holds what the latest plan read

RUL-merge_blocked_changes_nothing.content: A merge a precondition stops SHALL change nothing in the library, the workspace's photos or merge's records.
RUL-merge_blocked_changes_nothing.title: A merge a precondition stops changes nothing

RUL-merge_is_terminal.content: Merge SHALL be the last phase run in a workspace: once it succeeds, more media goes to a fresh workspace.
RUL-merge_is_terminal.title: Merge ends the workspace

RUL-merge_moves.content:
Merge SHALL move each photo it places, removing the workspace's copy only once the library's is verified in place — and
a photo already in the library likewise.
RUL-merge_moves.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_moves.title: Merge moves, and a photo leaves the workspace only once safe in the library

RUL-merge_outcome_recorded.content: Merge SHALL record whether its run succeeded whole, in part or not at all, or was refused before changing anything.
RUL-merge_outcome_recorded.section_name: 9. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
sections: 9. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
RUL-merge_outcome_recorded.title: Merge records how its run ended

RUL-merge_rechecks_gates.content:
Merge SHALL proceed only while the workspace, checked again at merge's own start, satisfies geotag's gates — what the
gates leave out, the videos, the files missing metadata, the redundant JPEGs and the strays, blocking merge no more
than geotag.
RUL-merge_rechecks_gates.title: Merge checks geotag's gates again

RUL-merge_rechecks_under_new_engine.content:
Under an ImageMagick version other than the one prep's fingerprints were taken by, merge SHALL take each photo's
fingerprint again before comparing it with the library's, a photo whose fingerprint changed left in photos by
destination, unmerged.
RUL-merge_rechecks_under_new_engine.title: Merge checks prep's fingerprints under another ImageMagick

RUL-merge_records_landing.content:
Merge SHALL record, in its own records, where each photo landed in the library, whether it was renamed there, which were
already present, and what blocked the rest.
RUL-merge_records_landing.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_records_landing.title: Merge records where every photo landed

RUL-merge_refuses_changed_since_finalize.content:
Merge SHALL refuse when photos by destination has changed since finalize — a refresh that changes only what describes a
prep run not counting as a change — so that what reaches the library is always the corrected, named, fully recorded set.
RUL-merge_refuses_changed_since_finalize.title: Merge refuses photos by destination changed since finalize

RUL-merge_replan_any_time.content: Merge SHALL allow a fresh plan at any time on a workspace not sealed, whatever an earlier run of it left.
RUL-merge_replan_any_time.title: A fresh plan is allowed at any time before the seal

RUL-merge_reseals.content:
A merge that succeeds SHALL remake the archival package to hold its own records too, as part of the same run and with no
command of its own.
RUL-merge_reseals.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_reseals.title: Merge remakes the package as part of its run

RUL-merge_resumable.content:
A merge interrupted SHALL be finished by running it again, which applies only what is outstanding — merging a batch
already merged changing nothing.
RUL-merge_resumable.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_resumable.title: Merge resumes, and a merged batch is a no-op

RUL-merge_run_reported.content:
At the end of an execution merge SHALL report what it placed in the library, what was already there, each photo left in
photos by destination with why, and whether the workspace is now sealed.
RUL-merge_run_reported.section_name: 9. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
sections: 9. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
RUL-merge_run_reported.title: Merge tells how its run ended

RUL-merge_snapshots_library.content: Merge's snapshot SHALL cover the workspace, and the library too where the library can be snapshotted.
RUL-merge_snapshots_library.title: Merge snapshots the workspace, and the library beside it

RUL-merge_suffix_above_highest.content: Merge SHALL take the suffix above the highest already used for a name, never a lower one that has come free.
RUL-merge_suffix_above_highest.title: Merge takes the suffix above the highest used

RUL-merge_takes_finalized_current.content:
Merge SHALL require that geotag's execution succeeded and the workspace was finalized, and refuse a workspace that was
not.
RUL-merge_takes_finalized_current.title: Merge requires a finalized workspace

RUL-metadata_freshness.content:
Prep SHALL reuse a file's cached metadata only while the file's path, size, modification time and fingerprint, and the
way the metadata was read — the extractor and its version, the fields, the options and the record's form — are as they
were when it was read.
RUL-metadata_freshness.section_name: 12. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 12. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-metadata_freshness.title: Cached metadata is reused only while read the same way

RUL-metadata_group_order.content:
Prep SHALL take each metadata field from the file's EXIF where EXIF holds it, else from its XMP, before any other place
the file records it — a time field from the first of them holding a valid time in it.
RUL-metadata_group_order.section_name: 12. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 12. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-metadata_group_order.title: A field is taken from the camera's own record first

RUL-metadata_kept_for_geotag.content:
Prep SHALL keep in the workspace database, for each media file it reads, the metadata geotag works from — the camera's
identity, the times and the native GPS position as recorded, and the file's dimensions, orientation and duration.
RUL-metadata_kept_for_geotag.section_name: 12. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 12. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-metadata_kept_for_geotag.title: Prep keeps the metadata geotag needs

RUL-misnamed_file_named.content: Prep SHALL name every misnamed file it finds, with the name the file should carry.
RUL-misnamed_file_named.title: Every misnamed file is named

RUL-misnamed_file_stops_prep.content:
A media file outside the inbox whose name is neither its timestamp name nor, lacking a recorded time, its untimed name
SHALL stop prep.
RUL-misnamed_file_stops_prep.title: A misnamed file outside the inbox stops prep

RUL-missing_folder_blocks.content:
On an initialized workspace, a missing managed folder SHALL block every phase, never recreated outside initialization:
no phase organizes media into a structure it had to rebuild.
RUL-missing_folder_blocks.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-missing_folder_blocks.title: A missing managed folder blocks, and is never rebuilt

RUL-missing_folder_named.content:
The block of a missing managed folder SHALL name the missing folders, say that something is wrong, and tell the user to
restore them and run again; an empty folder restores one.
RUL-missing_folder_named.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-missing_folder_named.title: The block names the missing folders

RUL-missing_metadata_stays.content:
Prep SHALL leave a file in missing metadata where it is, though it has since gained a recorded time: only the user
moving it back into the inbox takes it through prep again.
RUL-missing_metadata_stays.title: A file in missing metadata stays there

RUL-more_dumps_until_merge.content:
A new dump SHALL be accepted into the inbox at any point before merge, after a successful geotag too; the loop then
resumes from prep.
RUL-more_dumps_until_merge.title: More dumps may follow until merge

RUL-move_recognized.content:
Prep SHALL recognize as moved a file new to photos by destination whose size, modification time and name are those of
a file the workspace database holds and that is gone from its path — one only, matched by no other such file and by no
other new file in photos by destination.
RUL-move_recognized.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-move_recognized.title: A file the user moved is recognized

RUL-moved_file_carried.content:
Prep SHALL carry a moved file's row to its new path — reading nothing of the file but its size and time when the row
would have been reused at the old path, and otherwise reading the file again there as it would have been read at the
old.
RUL-moved_file_carried.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-moved_file_carried.title: A moved file's identity is carried, not read again

RUL-moved_photo_decided_anew.content:
A photo moved to another destination SHALL be decided under that destination's timezone and clock offset, nothing of
its old destination carried with it.
RUL-moved_photo_decided_anew.title: A moved photo is decided where it now is

RUL-mutate_on_difference.content:
In every phase and every run, a file SHALL be moved, renamed or written only where its current state differs from what
the run requires of it: a file already in its place, with its name and its metadata, produces no operation.
RUL-mutate_on_difference.title: A file is changed only where it differs

RUL-new_file_restales_plan.content:
A file found, at execution, anywhere prep scans that its plan did not record SHALL make the plan stale, refused before
any change.
RUL-new_file_restales_plan.title: A file that appeared since planning restales the plan

RUL-no_library_only_snapshot.content: Merge SHALL take no snapshot of the library alone.
RUL-no_library_only_snapshot.title: Merge takes no snapshot of the library alone

RUL-no_links.content:
A symbolic link anywhere among the managed files SHALL block, never followed, organized or skipped silently: a link to a
file anywhere; a link to a folder inside a dump or a managed folder, whose mere presence blocks though it is never
entered; a managed folder that is itself a link, before it is walked; a link at the top level.
RUL-no_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_links.title: No symbolic link is followed, and any link blocks

RUL-no_log_entry_for_other.content: A file of no media class SHALL have no entry in the log.
RUL-no_log_entry_for_other.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-no_log_entry_for_other.title: A file of no media class has no log entry

RUL-no_meaning_from_names.content: No phase SHALL read meaning from a file's name: its timestamp comes from its metadata.
RUL-no_meaning_from_names.title: No meaning is read from a file's name

RUL-no_op_run.content:
A phase run over a workspace whose relevant state has not changed SHALL change nothing, and produce the same result —
the same operations, fingerprints and names.
RUL-no_op_run.title: A run over unchanged inputs changes nothing

RUL-no_op_run_reports_reuse.content:
A run over unchanged inputs SHALL report the work it reused and the files already right, never treating earlier work as
an error.
RUL-no_op_run_reports_reuse.title: A run over unchanged inputs reports what it reused, never an error

RUL-no_plan_location_option.content: No command SHALL take an option saying where to put a plan or where to find one; the fixed place is the contract.
RUL-no_plan_location_option.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_plan_location_option.title: No command is told where a plan is

RUL-no_plan_no_run.content: A dry run or an execution that finds no plan in its place SHALL stop, and tell the user to plan first.
RUL-no_plan_no_run.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_plan_no_run.title: No plan, no dry run and no execution

RUL-no_record_before_decisions.content:
A geotag plan stopped before its first decision stage SHALL write no record of its own, saying what stopped it only in
its output.
RUL-no_record_before_decisions.title: No record before the first decision stage

RUL-not_inventoried.content:
Prep SHALL leave out of its inventory of media, each as a whole: the control records' place, the quarantine, a
version-control directory, and the strays folder with everything in it; and every hidden file.
RUL-not_inventoried.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-not_inventoried.title: What prep never inventories

RUL-nothing_built_from_merge_records.content: Nothing SHALL be built from merge's records.
RUL-nothing_built_from_merge_records.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-nothing_built_from_merge_records.title: Nothing is built from merge's records

RUL-offset_from_own_evidence.content:
Each offset SHALL be proposed only from that camera's own positions in that destination on that day, or from the
destination's timezone — never from the offset of another destination, whether one it lies in, one in it, or one beside
it.
RUL-offset_from_own_evidence.title: An offset is proposed from its own evidence only

RUL-offset_per_camera_destination_day.content:
Geotag SHALL decide a camera's clock offset once for each destination and each day it took photos there, by the
camera's own clock — a container destination, holding no photo, having none.
RUL-offset_per_camera_destination_day.title: One clock offset per camera, destination and day

RUL-one_configuration.content:
All three phases SHALL read their settings from the workspace's one configuration alone, each the settings it needs — no
phase keeping settings of its own, and no setting that governs a run coming from outside the workspace.
RUL-one_configuration.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-one_configuration.title: One configuration, read by every phase

RUL-one_database.content: A workspace SHALL hold exactly one database of record, and the library none.
RUL-one_database.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-one_database.title: One database, in the workspace

RUL-one_filename_format.content:
Prep and geotag SHALL name files from a timestamp in one format for the whole pipeline, not one for each phase, set by
the configuration and hard-coded by neither.
RUL-one_filename_format.title: One format, set by the configuration

RUL-one_filesystem_checked_every_run.content:
Every run of every phase on a workspace SHALL check, before it reads or changes anything, that the workspace lies on
one filesystem — never taking it as whole because an earlier run found it so.
RUL-one_filesystem_checked_every_run.title: The workspace's filesystem is checked each run

RUL-one_workspace_lock.content: A workspace SHALL have exactly one lock, shared by every command.
RUL-one_workspace_lock.title: A workspace has one lock

RUL-only_prep_builds_structure.content:
No phase but prep SHALL create or repair the workspace's structure; the folders merge creates in the library are
placement, not structure.
RUL-only_prep_builds_structure.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-only_prep_builds_structure.title: No other phase creates or repairs the structure

RUL-operations_atomic.content:
A move, a rename or a placement SHALL be one indivisible operation where the filesystem allows, so that an interruption
leaves the state before it or the state after, never part of either.
RUL-operations_atomic.title: An interrupted move leaves the before or the after

RUL-organization_settings_restale.content:
A change to the managed folders' names, or to which extensions are which class of media, SHALL make stale geotag's
executable plan and merge's plan.
RUL-organization_settings_restale.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-organization_settings_restale.title: A change to the folder names or the media classes restales the plans

RUL-other_databases_scratch.content:
Any database a phase keeps besides the database of record SHALL be scratch: holding no decision and no history, safe to
delete at any time, and neither journalled nor archived.
RUL-other_databases_scratch.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-other_databases_scratch.title: Any other database is scratch

RUL-other_outside_inbox_blocks.content: A file of no media class found in a managed folder other than the inbox SHALL block prep's plan, named.
RUL-other_outside_inbox_blocks.section_name: 6. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 6. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-other_outside_inbox_blocks.title: A file of no media class outside the inbox blocks prep

RUL-other_proposals_need_acceptance.content:
Every other proposal — a clock offset derived from the destination's timezone, a folder fallback position inherited
from the destination it lies in — SHALL take effect only once the user accepts it.
RUL-other_proposals_need_acceptance.title: Every other proposal waits for the user's acceptance

RUL-own_position_kept.content: Geotag SHALL never replace a photo's own GPS position.
RUL-own_position_kept.title: A photo's own position is kept

RUL-own_values_follow_new_fingerprint.content:
A photo whose fingerprint is taken again with a new value SHALL keep the own values geotag pinned for it under the old
one, so long as the change maps one value to one.
RUL-own_values_follow_new_fingerprint.title: A photo's own values follow its fingerprint's new value

RUL-package_contents.content:
The archival package SHALL hold every control record but the transient ones, archived together with its own list of
them: the configuration that governed the workspace; every current decision and plan record, exactly as the pipeline
validated it; the database, with its snapshot from the end of each phase; every phase's transformation log; and every
run's journal.
RUL-package_contents.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-package_contents.title: What the package holds

RUL-package_self_describing.content:
The package SHALL say which workspace it came from and which plan and execution it records, and list its contents with
each item's hash, so its integrity can be checked later.
RUL-package_self_describing.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-package_self_describing.title: The package describes itself

RUL-partial_history_shown.content:
A phase whose kept history cannot rebuild a photo's journey through it SHALL fail, or mark its record plainly partial —
never writing a log that looks whole but reflects only the last run.
RUL-partial_history_shown.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-partial_history_shown.title: A history too thin to rebuild is never shown as whole

RUL-phase_writes_own_records.content:
Each numbered record SHALL be written by the phase whose number it carries, and by no other: a phase MAY create, rewrite
or extend its own records across its runs, and reads every other phase's records read-only.
RUL-phase_writes_own_records.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-phase_writes_own_records.title: Each phase writes only its own records

RUL-phone_time_from_own_offset.content:
A phone's photo SHALL take its true time from the offset recorded with the time it was read from, else from its
destination's timezone.
RUL-phone_time_from_own_offset.title: A phone's time is read by the offset recorded with it

RUL-photos_by_date.content: Prep SHALL put each photo it takes in that has a recorded time into photos by date, under its timestamp name.
RUL-photos_by_date.title: Prep puts photos by date

RUL-placement_order.content:
A photo with no position of its own SHALL be placed by the first that applies: a position the user set for it, the
tracks at its resolved time, its destination's folder fallback; one none places waits for the user to set one or to
leave it unlocated.
RUL-placement_order.title: A photo is placed by the most specific source it has

RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.content:
Each phase's plan, and each of its decision records, SHALL have one fixed place among the control records, where the
phase's planning writes it and its dry run and its execution read it.
RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.title: Each plan has one fixed place

RUL-plan_carried_out_by_its_code.content:
Each phase SHALL carry out or summarise a saved plan only with the code that made it, refusing before any change a plan
made by other code or recording none.
RUL-plan_carried_out_by_its_code.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-plan_carried_out_by_its_code.title: A plan is carried out only by the code that made it

RUL-plan_memo_kept.content:
Prep's planning SHALL keep in the plan memo the fingerprint and metadata of each media file it read, for a later plan
to reuse.
RUL-plan_memo_kept.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-plan_memo_kept.title: A plan keeps what it read

RUL-planning_changes_no_media.content:
Planning SHALL change no media file, and write nothing but its plan, its decision records, what it keeps so that later
runs need not compute it again, and — on a workspace's first run — the configuration it seeds.
