RUL-planning_changes_no_media.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-planning_changes_no_media.title: Planning changes no media

RUL-position_written_whole.content:
A position geotag writes SHALL be written whole — latitude, longitude and their hemisphere references together — and
one it clears cleared whole.
RUL-position_written_whole.title: A position is written whole

RUL-prep_derives_camera_group.content:
Prep SHALL derive each file's camera group from its device-identity metadata, and record it both in what it hands
geotag and in its own records.
RUL-prep_derives_camera_group.title: Prep derives the camera group

RUL-prep_dry_run_changes_nothing.content: Prep's dry run SHALL change nothing in the workspace.
RUL-prep_dry_run_changes_nothing.title: A dry run changes nothing

RUL-prep_empties_inbox.content: A prep execution SHALL leave the inbox empty.
RUL-prep_empties_inbox.title: Prep leaves the inbox empty

RUL-prep_leaves_by_dest_as_found.content:
Prep SHALL leave photos by destination as it finds it: never moving a file into it, out of it or within it, nor
renaming, quarantining, deleting or writing one there.
RUL-prep_leaves_by_dest_as_found.section_name: 2. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
sections: 2. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
RUL-prep_leaves_by_dest_as_found.title: Prep leaves photos by destination as it finds it

RUL-prep_log_derived.content:
Prep's log SHALL be made from prep's plans, journals, quarantine evidence and database alone, holding nothing they do
not.
RUL-prep_log_derived.title: Prep's log is made from prep's own records

RUL-prep_log_records_set_aside.content:
Prep's log SHALL record each duplicate prep quarantined — where it was, where it went, and the copy kept — with the kept
copy's entry.
RUL-prep_log_records_set_aside.title: Prep's log names what it set aside

RUL-prep_name_provisional.content:
Prep SHALL derive a file's name from its raw timestamp, as the camera recorded it, for organizing and ordering only — a
provisional name, which prep never corrects, resolves to a timezone or converts to UTC.
RUL-prep_name_provisional.title: Prep's name is provisional

RUL-prep_no_time_or_gps.content: Prep SHALL make no correction to a file's time or position: it plans, infers, writes and applies none.
RUL-prep_no_time_or_gps.section_name: 2. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
sections: 2. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
RUL-prep_no_time_or_gps.title: Prep corrects no time and no position

RUL-prep_records_on_success.content:
Prep SHALL write its log and its handoff only at the end of an execution all of whose operations succeeded, each
written whole, never edited in place.
RUL-prep_records_on_success.title: Prep's records are written only by an execution that succeeded

RUL-prep_records_sort.content: Geotag SHALL NOT plan while photos by destination holds a photo prep has not recorded where it now is.
RUL-prep_records_sort.title: Geotag does not plan over an unrecorded sort

RUL-prep_replans.content:
After an interrupted execution, prep SHALL plan again from the workspace as it stands, never resuming or replaying the
interrupted plan.
RUL-prep_replans.title: An interrupted execution is planned again, not resumed

RUL-prep_run_summarised.content:
At the end of an execution prep SHALL report a summary telling what it changed apart from what it only read: its media
operations, the files already in place, the moves it recognized, the files of photos by destination it read, the
duplicates of files it may change apart from those of photos by destination, the metadata reused, extracted, carried
and failed, the blockers and warnings, and which records it wrote.
RUL-prep_run_summarised.title: Prep's run is summarised

RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.content: Prep SHALL ask the user for no decision, organizing from the state of the workspace and its configuration alone.
RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.title: Prep takes no decision

RUL-prepped_nothing_to_do.content:
On an initialized workspace whose inbox holds nothing — no file, and no folder — prep's dry run and execution SHALL
stop, changing nothing, and not carry out the saved plan.
RUL-prepped_nothing_to_do.title: A prepped workspace has nothing to do

RUL-prune_explicit.content:
Prep SHALL delete quarantined files only by its prune command, which lists what it would delete unless told to delete,
and touches nothing outside the quarantine.
RUL-prune_explicit.title: Only the user's prune deletes, and only when told to

RUL-quarantine_footprint_reported.content:
Each prep plan SHALL report the quarantine's size — its files, their bytes, and the runs that filled it, oldest and
newest.
RUL-quarantine_footprint_reported.title: The quarantine's size is reported

RUL-quarantine_never_auto_deleted.content: No prep run SHALL remove anything from the quarantine, however often it runs and however old the quarantine is.
RUL-quarantine_never_auto_deleted.title: No run deletes from the quarantine

RUL-quarantined_leaves_database.content: A file prep has quarantined SHALL be in neither the workspace database nor the handoff.
RUL-quarantined_leaves_database.section_name: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 10. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-quarantined_leaves_database.title: A quarantined file leaves the database

RUL-record_whole_each_phase.content:
At the end of every phase the workspace SHALL hold a complete, self-sufficient, human-readable record of everything done
to its files so far: whole whether or not any later phase ever runs, extended by each phase through its own work, a
phase not yet run reading as the workspace not having advanced, never as a record incomplete.
RUL-record_whole_each_phase.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-record_whole_each_phase.title: The record is whole at the end of every phase

RUL-recorded_time_order.content:
A file's recorded time SHALL be read from the first of its `DateTimeOriginal`, `CreateDate` and `ModifyDate` that
holds a valid time; a field present but holding none is passed over.
RUL-recorded_time_order.title: Which field is the recorded time

RUL-redundant_jpeg_set_aside.content:
Prep SHALL move into redundant JPEGs each JPEG in the inbox that shares its folder and its name, extension aside, with a
raw file — and no other file with it.
RUL-redundant_jpeg_set_aside.title: A JPEG beside its RAW is set aside

RUL-redundant_jpg_timestamp_named.content:
A JPG prep sets aside as redundant to its RAW SHALL get its timestamp name, or with no recorded time its untimed name,
as any file prep files does.
RUL-redundant_jpg_timestamp_named.title: A redundant JPG gets its timestamp name

RUL-rehash_explained.content:
Each prep plan SHALL report how many media files it fingerprinted again, and why, and how many fingerprints it took
from the plan memo — deciding nothing by it.
RUL-rehash_explained.section_name: 17. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 17. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-rehash_explained.title: A fingerprint taken again is explained

RUL-remake_only_what_depends.content: When an input changes, only the records that depend on it SHALL be made again, every other record left as it is.
RUL-remake_only_what_depends.title: Only what depends on a change is made again

RUL-replan_carries_placed.content:
A fresh plan SHALL account for every finalized photo no longer in photos by destination: carried forward with the
library place the latest earlier plan of the workspace gave it whose place, fingerprinted again, holds it — whether or
not the journal recorded the move — and otherwise blocking, naming why.
RUL-replan_carries_placed.title: A fresh plan carries the photos earlier plans placed

RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.content:
Re-planning SHALL never overwrite a plan or a decision record: when what it makes differs from what is saved, the saved
one is first set aside, recoverably, and the user told where.
RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.title: Re-planning sets the prior plan aside

RUL-required_snapshot_or_nothing.content: When the configuration requires snapshots, a run that cannot take one SHALL stop before it changes anything.
RUL-required_snapshot_or_nothing.title: A required snapshot that fails stops the run

RUL-reread_whole.content:
A media file whose metadata prep reads again — the way metadata is read having changed — SHALL be fingerprinted again
with it.
RUL-reread_whole.title: A file read again is read whole

RUL-rerun_does_what_changed.content:
A re-run SHALL redo exactly the work its changed inputs require — new media, an edited setting, changed tracks, a
withdrawn or altered decision, a refreshed handoff — and no more. It MAY ask for new decisions, but only for the items
the change affects.
RUL-rerun_does_what_changed.title: A re-run does as much as what changed requires

RUL-reseal_rederives_nothing.content: Merge SHALL remake the package from the records as they stand, re-deriving nothing of an earlier phase.
RUL-reseal_rederives_nothing.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-reseal_rederives_nothing.title: Remaking the package re-derives nothing

RUL-restored_file_is_new.content:
A file the user moves from the quarantine back into the inbox SHALL be handled as a new file of the dump, its earlier
quarantine record left as it is.
RUL-restored_file_is_new.title: A file restored from the quarantine is a new file

RUL-resume_rechecks_library.content:
A photo gone from photos by destination SHALL count as merged only while its library place, fingerprinted again, holds
it — whatever the journal or the plan says — and otherwise block, the run then partial.
RUL-resume_rechecks_library.title: A resumed merge checks the library, not the journal

RUL-reuse_valid_work.content:
Work already done and still valid SHALL be reused, not repeated — a file's content and metadata read, and the tracks
parsed, only for inputs that are new or have changed.
RUL-reuse_valid_work.title: Valid work is reused

RUL-revisit_matched_to_its_day.content:
Photos of a place the tracks passed on several visits — the same destination on consecutive days, a place passed
morning and evening — SHALL anchor their camera's clock by the visit the camera's photos agree on, never by another
visit's track because it passed closer.
RUL-revisit_matched_to_its_day.section_name: 19. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 19. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-revisit_matched_to_its_day.title: A place visited on several days is matched to the photo's day

RUL-rewrite_in_place_atomic.content:
A write that rewrites a file in place SHALL leave, if interrupted, the intact original or the fully written file —
never a damaged one between them.
RUL-rewrite_in_place_atomic.omit_reason: crash-injection testing is out of scope; the guarantee rests on how the file is written
RUL-rewrite_in_place_atomic.title: A file rewritten in place is the old one or the new one

RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.content:
A rewrite of the handoff that changes only what describes the run, not its content, SHALL NOT make anything downstream
stale.
RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.title: Refreshing what describes the run restales nothing

RUL-seal_is_authority.content: Whether a workspace is finished SHALL be read from its seal alone, never from the state of its folders.
RUL-seal_is_authority.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-seal_is_authority.title: The seal alone says a workspace is finished

RUL-seal_on_success_only.content:
Merge SHALL seal the workspace only when it succeeds whole — every photo by destination placed in the library or found
already there, none left — a partial, failed or interrupted merge leaving it unsealed.
RUL-seal_on_success_only.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-seal_on_success_only.title: Only a whole merge seals

RUL-sealed_new_dump_left.content: A command refusing a sealed workspace SHALL leave a new dump it finds there exactly where it is.
RUL-sealed_new_dump_left.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_new_dump_left.title: A new dump in a sealed workspace is left where it is

RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.content:
A command refusing a sealed workspace that finds anything where a dump would land — an entry at the workspace's top
level other than its managed folders and hidden entries, or anything in the inbox — SHALL say that a new dump is likely
there and must go to a fresh workspace.
RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.title: A new dump in a sealed workspace is pointed out

RUL-sealed_no_library_recorded.content: Merge's library setup SHALL NOT record a library in a sealed workspace's configuration.
RUL-sealed_no_library_recorded.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_no_library_recorded.title: A sealed workspace's configuration records no library

RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.content: Pruning the quarantine SHALL remain allowed in a sealed workspace — the only change allowed there.
RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.title: Pruning the quarantine is still allowed

RUL-sealed_refuses.content:
In a sealed workspace prep, geotag and merge SHALL stop as they start, changing nothing but the owner record of the
workspace lock. Its records MAY still be read.
RUL-sealed_refuses.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_refuses.title: A sealed workspace is never processed again

RUL-shape_checked_first.content:
Each phase SHALL check the workspace's shape at its start — right after the lock and the seal check, before it scans,
plans or changes anything.
RUL-shape_checked_first.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-shape_checked_first.title: The shape is checked first

RUL-sidecar_blocks.content:
An editing sidecar — a file holding a photo's development beside it — found anywhere prep inventories SHALL block
prep's plan.
RUL-sidecar_blocks.section_name: 6. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 6. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-sidecar_blocks.title: An editing sidecar blocks prep

RUL-snapshot_off_by_default.content: Snapshots SHALL be off unless the workspace's configuration turns them on.
RUL-snapshot_off_by_default.title: No snapshot unless configured

RUL-snapshot_optional.content:
A phase that changes files MAY first take a snapshot of what it is about to change, from which the whole change can be
rolled back. Cartographer SHALL be complete and safe without one, no guarantee depending on a snapshot having been
taken.
RUL-snapshot_optional.title: A snapshot is optional, and nothing rests on it

RUL-snapshot_per_plan.content: Each snapshot SHALL be identifiable by the plan whose changes it precedes.
RUL-snapshot_per_plan.title: A snapshot names its plan

RUL-snapshot_timing.content:
A snapshot SHALL be taken after the plan has been validated against its dependencies and the lock is held, and before
the plan's first change.
RUL-snapshot_timing.title: When a snapshot is taken

RUL-sort_photos_only.content:
Photos by destination SHALL hold only photos — videos stay in videos by date, and no file of no media class belongs
there — geotag refusing to run while it holds anything else.
RUL-sort_photos_only.title: Only photos are sorted into photos by destination

RUL-sort_recorded_by_stat.content:
A prep run after the latest sort SHALL record the moves from the files' sizes and modification times alone, carrying
each moved file's identity forward without reading it again.
RUL-sort_recorded_by_stat.title: Prep records a sort from sizes and times alone

RUL-spanning_workspace_located.content: The report of a workspace spanning filesystems SHALL name a folder in it that lies on another filesystem.
RUL-spanning_workspace_located.title: The stop names a folder that lies elsewhere

RUL-spanning_workspace_stops.content: A workspace found to span filesystems SHALL stop the run with nothing changed.
RUL-spanning_workspace_stops.title: A workspace spanning filesystems stops the run

RUL-split_move_never_lost.content:
Where a move cannot be one operation, an interruption, or a failure partway, SHALL leave the file whole under its old
name, its new name or both — never under neither, never part of one.
RUL-split_move_never_lost.title: A move that cannot be one operation is never lost

RUL-stale_lock_recovered.content:
A lock left behind by a run that died SHALL be recognisable as stale, and recoverable, so that a crash never leaves a
workspace locked for good.
RUL-stale_lock_recovered.title: A stale lock is recognised and recovered

RUL-stale_takeover_conservative.content:
A stale lock SHALL be taken over only when its owner is provably gone; a lock whose owner may still be running is left
alone.
RUL-stale_takeover_conservative.title: Only a dead owner's lock is taken over

RUL-staleness_by_area.content:
A change to one area of the configuration SHALL make stale only what depends on that area. A change to the track
thresholds restales placement and the plans, not the renames; a change to the filename format restales the renames,
not placement.
RUL-staleness_by_area.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-staleness_by_area.title: A change to one area restales only what depends on it

RUL-stray_media_hinted.content:
When files prep is about to set aside as strays are images or videos by their content, prep SHALL warn, naming their
extension.
RUL-stray_media_hinted.section_name: 6. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 6. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-stray_media_hinted.title: Media set aside as strays is pointed out

RUL-strays_leave_no_trace.content:
A file prep moves to the strays folder SHALL be recorded nowhere but in the journal of that move: no fingerprint, no row
in the workspace database, no entry in any log, no place in the archival package.
RUL-strays_leave_no_trace.section_name: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 3. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-strays_leave_no_trace.title: A stray leaves no trace but its move

RUL-strays_never_processed.content: Nothing SHALL process the strays folder's contents again: prep writes into it, but never scans it.
RUL-strays_never_processed.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-strays_never_processed.title: The strays folder's contents are never processed again

RUL-structure_built_once.content:
Prep SHALL create the full structure of managed folders exactly once, when it initializes the workspace, and never
remove one.
RUL-structure_built_once.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-structure_built_once.title: Prep builds the structure once, and never removes a folder

RUL-suffix_choice_by_phase.content:
Prep and geotag SHALL take the first free name — the name with no suffix when it is free, otherwise the lowest free
suffix — by one identical rule.
RUL-suffix_choice_by_phase.title: Prep and geotag take the first free name

RUL-suffix_no_clobber.content:
A file whose timestamp name is already taken SHALL get a zero-padded differentiating suffix, allocated deterministically
and without clobbering: against every name on disk and every name planned in the run, compared without regard to case,
so that two files never collide.
RUL-suffix_no_clobber.title: A taken name gets a suffix, never clobbering

RUL-target_free_at_execute.content:
Immediately before each change that gives a file a name — prep's moves, renames and setting duplicates aside, geotag's
renames, merge's placing in the library — execution SHALL check that the name is free, ignoring case where the
filesystem does, never writing onto a taken name on the strength of the plan: a name found taken blocks that operation.
RUL-target_free_at_execute.title: Every name is checked free as it is written

RUL-temp_name_own.content: A temporary copy SHALL bear a name of its own, which no photo bears.
RUL-temp_name_own.title: A temporary copy bears a name no photo bears

RUL-time_before_gps.content: Geotag SHALL plan no photo's position until every photo's true time is resolved.
RUL-time_before_gps.title: Time first, then position

RUL-times_survive_unrelated_config_edits.content: A configuration change outside the camera-time policy SHALL NOT make stale the true times already resolved.
RUL-times_survive_unrelated_config_edits.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-times_survive_unrelated_config_edits.title: Resolved true times survive configuration edits outside the time policy

RUL-timezone_auto_resolves.content:
A destination's proposed timezone — inherited from the destination it lies in, or the configured default — SHALL take
effect without the user's answer, a timezone the user writes overriding it; a destination with no proposal waits for the
user.
RUL-timezone_auto_resolves.title: A destination's timezone applies itself

RUL-timezone_from_nearest.content:
A destination's proposed timezone SHALL be the one in effect at the nearest destination it lies in that has one —
however it was reached there — and the configured default only where none has.
RUL-timezone_from_nearest.title: A destination takes the nearest timezone it lies in

RUL-tool_failure_retried.content:
A tool that fails or crashes on a file SHALL be restarted and tried again a bounded number of times before the file's
fingerprint or metadata is recorded as failed — never as valid.
RUL-tool_failure_retried.section_name: 17. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 17. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-tool_failure_retried.title: A tool's failure is retried before it counts

RUL-top_level_only_managed.aliases: struct-base-folders-only-1, prep-post-init-base-folders-only-1, merge-block-misplaced-root-entry-1, geotag-misplaced-root-hardstop-1, prep-block-msg-points-to-sources-1, prep-root-dotfile-left-1, prep-root-entry-blocks-1
RUL-top_level_only_managed.content:
The top level of an initialized workspace SHALL hold only the managed folders, the control records' place, the
quarantine and hidden entries, hidden files as much as hidden folders: any other entry — a file, a folder, a link, an
entry of any other kind — is a misplaced dump, whose only place is the
inbox, and blocks every phase alike.
RUL-top_level_only_managed.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-top_level_only_managed.title: The top level holds only what belongs there

RUL-track_file_left_in_place.content:
Prep SHALL leave a track file where it is: never moving it, to the strays folder or anywhere else, and never treating it
as a file of no media class.
RUL-track_file_left_in_place.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-track_file_left_in_place.title: A track file stays where it is

RUL-track_files_block_prep.content:
A track file — a recorded position log in any of the usual formats, whether or not geotag reads that format — found
anywhere prep inventories, in the dump or in a managed folder, SHALL block prep's plan.
RUL-track_files_block_prep.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-track_files_block_prep.title: A track file stops prep

RUL-track_time_never_guessed.content:
Geotag SHALL take a track point's time as the instant it states — whatever its precision or the offset it is written
with — never guessing the zone of one that states none.
RUL-track_time_never_guessed.title: A track point's time is the instant it states

RUL-tracks_geotag_only.content:
Geotag SHALL be the only phase that reads the tracks — scanning their location, parsing them, fingerprinting them and
using them as evidence; prep never reads, parses, fingerprints or moves them, nor otherwise acts on them.
RUL-tracks_geotag_only.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_geotag_only.title: Only geotag reads the tracks

RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.content:
Geotag SHALL record the tracks' fingerprint as a dependency of every record it derives with them — the time decisions,
the drift validation, the GPS decisions and the executable plan — so that a change to the tracks makes those records
stale.
RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.title: The tracks are a dependency of what geotag derives from them

RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.content:
The tracks' location SHALL lie outside the managed folders — neither inside one nor containing one — a configuration
that places it otherwise being refused before any phase uses it. Where outside them is the configuration's choice, not
part of this contract.
RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.title: The tracks lie outside the managed folders

RUL-unanchored_offset_confirmed.content:
Photos SHALL NOT be placed by the tracks on a clock offset the camera's own GPS does not support until the user has
confirmed that offset against the tracks — an untouched check never counting as a confirmation.
RUL-unanchored_offset_confirmed.title: An offset the camera's GPS does not support is confirmed before photos are placed by it

RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.content: A re-plan whose result is identical to what is saved SHALL write nothing and set nothing aside.
RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.title: An unchanged re-plan writes nothing

RUL-unchecked_counts_as_changed.content: A dependency that is missing, or cannot be checked, SHALL count as changed.
RUL-unchecked_counts_as_changed.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-unchecked_counts_as_changed.title: What cannot be checked counts as changed

RUL-uncorrected_keeps_its_name.content:
A file's name SHALL change between prep and geotag only when its timestamp is corrected: geotag plans no rename for a
file whose time is not corrected.
RUL-uncorrected_keeps_its_name.title: An uncorrected file keeps its name

RUL-unidentified_files_solved_alone.content:
A file whose metadata names no camera SHALL be solved on its own — by the offset recorded with its time, else its
destination's timezone — never asked to be classed, nor given a camera's clock offset.
RUL-unidentified_files_solved_alone.title: A file naming no camera is solved on its own

RUL-unknown_group_classification_offered.content:
Geotag SHALL offer the classification of every unknown camera group ready to paste into the configuration, every
group already classed kept as it is.
RUL-unknown_group_classification_offered.title: The classification is offered ready to paste

RUL-unknown_group_stops_geotag.content: Geotag SHALL NOT decide anything while a camera group in photos by destination is unknown.
RUL-unknown_group_stops_geotag.title: An unknown camera group stops geotag

RUL-unlisted_extension_other.content: An extension the configuration does not list SHALL be `other`.
RUL-unlisted_extension_other.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-unlisted_extension_other.title: An extension not listed is other

RUL-unplaced_photo_stays.content: A photo merge cannot place SHALL stay where it is, the run then partial.
RUL-unplaced_photo_stays.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-unplaced_photo_stays.title: A photo merge cannot place stays where it is

RUL-unreadable_point_reported.content:
A track point geotag cannot use — no position or one out of range, no time, an unreadable time, or one stating no
zone — SHALL be skipped and reported to the user, naming its file and point.
RUL-unreadable_point_reported.title: A track point geotag cannot use is reported

RUL-unrequired_snapshot_proceeds.content:
When snapshots are not required, or not configured, a run SHALL proceed without one. Its safety then rests, as it
always does, on the journal, the recoverable quarantine, never overwriting, and the filesystem as the truth.
RUL-unrequired_snapshot_proceeds.title: Without a required snapshot, the run goes on

RUL-unsettled_collision_blocks.content:
Where the library file in an incoming photo's place cannot be fingerprinted, merge SHALL leave that photo in photos by
destination — neither placing it there nor under another name — and go on with the rest.
RUL-unsettled_collision_blocks.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-unsettled_collision_blocks.title: A collision that cannot be settled holds the photo back

RUL-untimed_mark_once.content:
A file that comes in under a name already carrying the untimed mark SHALL keep that name as its untimed name, the mark
not added again.
RUL-untimed_mark_once.title: The untimed mark is taken once

RUL-untimed_photo_stops_geotag.content:
A photo in photos by destination carrying no recorded time SHALL stop geotag before it plans anything, named as
belonging in missing metadata.
RUL-untimed_photo_stops_geotag.title: A photo with no recorded time stops geotag

RUL-untimed_to_missing_metadata.content:
Prep SHALL put each media file it takes in with no recorded time directly into missing metadata, no day folder between,
under its untimed name.
RUL-untimed_to_missing_metadata.title: Media with no recorded time goes to missing metadata

RUL-user_writes_decisions.content: A decision field SHALL be written by the user alone, no phase ever overwriting what the user wrote.
RUL-user_writes_decisions.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-user_writes_decisions.title: The user writes the decisions

RUL-videos_by_date.content: Prep SHALL put each video it takes in that has a recorded time into videos by date, under its timestamp name.
RUL-videos_by_date.section_name: 2. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
sections: 2. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
RUL-videos_by_date.title: Prep puts videos by date

RUL-who_checks_for_links.content: Prep SHALL check for links across the whole tree it walks, the destination tree included though prep never changes it.
RUL-who_checks_for_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-who_checks_for_links.title: Prep checks the whole tree for links

RUL-withdrawal_undoes.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-withdrawal_undoes.title: Withdrawing a decision undoes it

RUL-workspace_moves_one_filesystem.content: A move by prep or geotag that would cross filesystems SHALL fail, never be made a copy.
RUL-workspace_moves_one_filesystem.title: Prep and geotag never move across filesystems

RUL-workspace_one_filesystem.content:
A workspace SHALL lie on one filesystem, every folder in it — the control records' and the set-aside duplicates'
among them — on the same one.
RUL-workspace_one_filesystem.title: A workspace lies on one filesystem

TST-cli-dry_run_mutates_nothing_on_disk.title: Dry-run is validation, not simulation, and is strictly read-only: it loads the saved plan, validates it against an in-memory DB, and prints a summary. Snapshot the whole control dir + a seeded quarantine, run dry-run, assert every on-disk byte is identical (cache, plan, quarantine).

TST-cli-dry_run_summarizes_not_dumps.title: test dry run summarizes not dumps

TST-cli-locked_workspace_failfast_produc.title: Lock contention is fail-fast and pre-mutation: a `plan` that can't take the workspace lock produces NO plan artifact and NO journal — the run never got past lock acquisition.

TST-cli-prep_plan_never_auto_deletes_qua.title: Quarantine is recoverable and is NEVER auto-purged: an ordinary prep `plan` leaves a populated quarantine completely intact (only the explicit `prune-quarantine` command may remove it).

TST-cli-prune_quarantine_is_the_sole_op_.title: The seal blocks ONLY plan/dry-run/execute; prune-quarantine is the sole maintenance op that still runs on a sealed (terminal) workspace — quarantine cleanup must survive the seal. Assert it is NOT refused with exit-2 SEALED, and that the --yes delete actually clears the quarantine.

TST-cli-prune_quarantine_preserves_manag.title: prune-quarantine removes only quarantine contents — the managed 0-6 tree (incl. 6-photos-by-dest) is never touched by a prune run.

TST-cli-sealed_new_dump_is_left_exactly_.title: The sealed-workspace new-dump path only WARNS — it never relocates the dumped file. After the refusal the file is byte-identical at its original 0-sources path (the operator must move it to a fresh workspace themselves; prep touches nothing).

TST-concurrency-exiftool_pool_failure_bl.title: test exiftool pool failure blocks plan

TST-config-config_fingerprint_is_file_sh.title: test config fingerprint is file sha and in handoff

TST-config_validation-classification_fol.title: test classification follows config after load

TST-config_validation-config_rechecked_o.title: test config rechecked on every read

TST-config_validation-field_fingerprints.title: test field fingerprints change with their area

TST-config_validation-gpx_root_overlappi.title: test gpx root overlapping the managed folders is refused[0-sources/gpx]

TST-fallbacks-cross_fs_move_refuses_a_co.title: A copy of the right size but one byte off — damage a fingerprint of the decoded image would not see, in the metadata geotag wrote, say — is refused: the source kept, no destination, no temp.

TST-fallbacks-move_no_clobber_refuses_ex.title: Only merge crosses filesystems: for prep and geotag (no cross_fs) a move that would cross one is raised as a failure, never turned into a copy — the source stays and no temp is left.

TST-fingerprints-a_dependency_missing_or.title: A dependency that cannot be checked — its record gone, or the plan recording none — counts as changed: execution refuses the plan before its first change.

TST-fingerprints-a_failed_fingerprint_is.title: A failed fingerprint is offered for reuse neither by the plan memo nor by the database: once the machine is fixed, the next plan takes it, the file's size and time unchanged.

TST-fingerprints-a_file_whose_metadata_i.title: Metadata read by another way than the one in use is read again, and the file's fingerprint with it.

TST-fingerprints-a_fingerprint_is_reused.title: A cached fingerprint is reused only when taken by the method this build uses: the same strategy and, for a photo, the same ImageMagick version — one recording none is taken again; a video's is bound to its strategy alone.

TST-fingerprints-a_new_or_changed_file_i.title: A file the database holds no fingerprint for is fingerprinted; an unchanged one is not; one whose modification time changed is fingerprinted again.

TST-fingerprints-a_retaken_fingerprint_r.title: A file fingerprinted again only because the method changed keeps its fresh metadata, reported as reused — not as a failed extraction.

TST-fingerprints-execute_writes_the_data.title: Each execute writes the current versions into the database's version row, over what it held.

TST-fingerprints-handoff_vouches_for_the.title: Prep's execution records in its handoff the hash of the log it wrote — outside the handoff's content, so a pointer refreshed by a run that changed nothing makes nothing downstream stale.

TST-fingerprints-media_carries_fingerpri.title: test media carries fingerprint and no byte hash

TST-geotag_executable_plan-gps_write_car.title: §28.1: EXIF coordinates are unsigned magnitudes — a write without GPSLatitudeRef/ GPSLongitudeRef reads as NO location to a conforming reader, and flips the hemisphere of a southern/western position for a lenient one. TST-geotag_executable_plan-plan_ready_wi.title: test plan ready with ops and full depends on

TST-geotag_execution-a_plan_made_by_othe.title: Geotag's executable plan records the code that made it; another build, or a plan recording none, makes it stale before any change.

TST-geotag_execution-an_edit_made_since_.title: test an edit made since the plan is never overwritten

TST-geotag_execution-content_changed_wri.title: test content changed write flags mismatch

TST-geotag_execution-every_write_traces_.title: From the journal of what ran, each confirmed operation is found in the plan, and the plan names by hash the decision records it was made from, which hold the decision for that photo's destination.

TST-geotag_execution-geotag_leaves_confi.title: Geotag never writes the workspace config (photos-00-config.json is hand-edited, authoritative). Snapshot its bytes, drive the full plan + execute, assert byte-for-byte identical (the geotag half of config-merge-readonly; the merge half is covered in test_merge_execute).

TST-geotag_execution-rename_target_occup.title: test rename target occupied at execute blocks

TST-geotag_execution-revalidate_detects_.title: test revalidate detects each stale input

TST-geotag_execution_real-a_written_phot.title: Against the real binary: a photo geotag wrote reads back as holding every planned value — time, offset, position, references, marker — which is how execute tells its own interrupted write from an edit made since the plan; an edit to one tag no longer reads back as the plan.

TST-geotag_execution_real-exif_write_pre.title: The seam the executor relies on, against the real binaries: write EXIF, fingerprint is stable.

TST-geotag_execution_real-planned_gps_wr.title: §28.1 against the real binary: the tags `plan_file_ops` plans must land a fix a conforming reader can use. Coordinate-only writes were readable to exiftool's lenient composite but carried no GPSLatitudeRef/GPSLongitudeRef, so exiv2/digiKam saw NO location — and `-n` stored a negative coordinate as its magnitude, flipping the hemisphere. Assert the raw ref tags AND the signed round-trip, since the composite alone would pass even with the refs missing.

TST-geotag_finalize-a_cleared_position_i.title: A position geotag wrote and no longer places is cleared, and the log says so with the position the photo held; a manual position records the one it replaced.

TST-geotag_finalize-a_decision_changed_s.title: test a decision changed since execution stops finalize

TST-geotag_finalize-an_offset_is_describ.title: test an offset is described in words

TST-geotag_finalize-complete_log_superse.title: test complete log superset and geotag steps

TST-geotag_finalize-each_step_names_its_.title: The offset names its exact cell — with its day when the camera's photos there span days — or the drift confirmation that replaced it; a manual position names the pin or the folder fallback.

TST-geotag_finalize-finalize_archives_th.title: The package is the whole control directory but its transient files — the drift record and every journal among it — listed with their hashes in the manifest and archived, manifest included, into the control directory itself.

TST-geotag_finalize-finalize_assembles_p.title: test finalize assembles package and is nondestructive

TST-geotag_finalize-finalize_records_eac.title: Finalize records every by-dest photo as geotag left it — under its final, renamed path — by size and modification time, so merge can refuse one changed after.

TST-geotag_finalize-finalize_refuses_a_p.title: Finalize copies prep's log only as the handoff records it, by hash: a log changed since — or gone, which cannot be checked — stops finalize, nothing written, and sends the user back to prep.

TST-geotag_gps_ledger-a_pin_executed_the.title: test a pin executed then withdrawn plans and executes again

TST-geotag_gps_ledger-a_withdrawal_never.title: Withdrawing a decision changes GPS only as any plan would: geotag has no revert operation at all (time writes and renames are forward-idempotent), and it never moves a photo across destinations.

TST-geotag_gps_ledger-a_withdrawn_pin_is.title: A pin withdrawn from a photo that had no GPS, the photo accepted as unlocated: the plan, deciding from its own values, clears geotag's position, and records the position it clears.
Withdrawn, the pin gives way to the position the tracks give the photo's own time: recomputed, not rolled back to anything stored.

TST-geotag_gps_ledger-own_values_pinned_.title: §29.1a: a photo's own values are committed to the ledger BEFORE geotag's first write to it. Order-probe both seams during execute and assert the pin precedes the write.

The handoff carries a SENTINEL group key that the identity fields (Make/Model/serial) could never compose — if geotag recomputed from CAMERA_IDENTITY_FIELDS it would land on a different key. build_file_model and recognize_camera_groups must use the handoff's key verbatim.

TST-geotag_offset_inference-clock_error_.title: §19.1: the clock-error matching window reads the frame's naive time AS UTC; the destination timezone is never used to bound matching. The matcher takes no timezone, and decorating the frame + cfg with a destination timezone leaves the match identical. Discriminating: the window is tight (3h) so if the naive time were re-read through a destination tz (Tokyo +9 / Honolulu -10, hours off) the GPX point would fall outside the window and the match would vanish — it does not.

TST-geotag_preflight-a_missing_setting_s.title: A setting missing from the workspace's configuration is never filled from the program's defaults: prep's load, geotag and merge each stop, naming the setting and the value to add.

TST-geotag_preflight-a_photo_removed_or_.title: A by-dest photo prep recorded that is now gone, or differs in size or modification time from its record (a time edited in another program, say), stops planning with the re-prep blocker: geotag never plans on prep's reading of a file that no longer holds it.

TST-geotag_preflight-a_photo_with_no_rec.title: A photo sorted into a destination by hand with no recorded time can never be resolved to its true time: geotag stops before planning anything, naming it as belonging in missing metadata — the photo with a time passes unnamed.

TST-geotag_preflight-an_unknown_setting_.title: A setting cartographer does not know is never ignored: prep's load, geotag and merge each stop, naming it — the user would otherwise believe it took effect.

TST-geotag_preflight-auto_reprep_runs_in.title: Geotag takes the workspace lock before it reads anything, and runs prep's plan and execute for a clean sort inside that same lock — no read before it, no other run slipping in between.

TST-geotag_preflight-auto_reprep_runs_pr.title: A recorded by-dest photo changed since prep (0-sources empty) is brought up to date the same way: geotag plan runs prep's plan then execute.

TST-geotag_preflight-dev_subfolder_block.title: test dev subfolder blocks at execute

TST-geotag_preflight-directory_symlink_a.title: A symlink at the root is barred outright as a forbidden symlink (§13), never followed — checked before the structural/misplaced-folder guards.

TST-geotag_preflight-every_misplaced_roo.title: Any other top-level entry blocks, whatever its kind — a named pipe too — and the block names every one, not only the first.

TST-geotag_preflight-filename_format_oth.title: test filename format other than prep s blocks

TST-geotag_preflight-geotag_and_merge_cr.title: Run in a folder that is not a workspace, geotag and merge stop without creating the control directory — not even for their lock file. Only prep creates it.

TST-geotag_preflight-geotag_classifies_b.title: Geotag reads the workspace's own configuration, extension lists included: a `.webp` the user listed as an image is a photo in photos by destination, not a file of no media class — whatever the built-in lists say.

TST-geotag_preflight-geotag_never_repair.title: test geotag never repairs a missing folder

TST-geotag_preflight-handoff_of_another_.title: test handoff of another derivation version blocks[camera group key version]

TST-geotag_preflight-other_file_in_by_de.title: test other file in by dest blocks

TST-geotag_preflight-photo_left_in_by_da.title: test photo left in by date blocks

TST-geotag_preflight-root_hidden_file_al.title: A hidden file at the top level (a file manager's `.directory`) is a hidden entry, not a misplaced dump: it blocks nothing (shared contract §4).

TST-geotag_preflight-unrecorded_by_dest_.title: test unrecorded by dest photo demands reprep

TST-geotag_preflight-video_in_by_dest_bl.title: test video in by dest blocks

TST-geotag_rename_planning-move_between_.title: Moving a photo to a new destination re-evaluates its name under the NEW dest's timezone — the old destination's local time is never carried. geotag re-derives every run from the handoff (it keeps no cross-run resolution cache), so the same resolved UTC under Brussels vs Tokyo yields different destination-local names.

TST-geotag_rename_planning-only_a_numeri.title: test only a numeric suffix counts

TST-geotag_rename_planning-suffixed_name.title: test suffixed name of the right time kept

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-a_copy_that_wou.title: Were finalize's copy to change prep's record, finalize writes nothing and says so.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-a_devices_own_m.title: A phone's own GPSProcessingMethod is not geotag's: its position is kept and its time is not taken as corrected. Geotag's time mark is appended to the phone's value, never replacing it, and read back the phone's GPS is still native while its time is fixed.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-a_fingerprint_m.title: test a fingerprint mapping not one to one stops geotag

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-a_history_too_t.title: Finalize never shows as whole what it cannot rebuild: a photo carrying geotag's mark that no pass here first corrected is marked partial, and a pass whose plan is gone is named in a warning.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-a_marked_photo_.title: A photo geotag marked before (elsewhere) holds no original values: nothing is pinned, and its time is taken as fixed.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-a_photo_whose_f.title: test a photo whose fingerprint changed keeps its own values

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-changed_offset_.title: A wrong offset, once executed, is fixed in the record: the re-run works from the photo's own camera time and corrects it once, under the new offset.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-finalize_carrie.title: Finalize's log carries prep's every field and step unchanged, a note of prep's among them, and adds only its own: geotag's note goes in a step of its own.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-geotag_position.title: A position geotag wrote is not the file's own: the re-run places the file from the track again and overwrites a fix that no longer agrees, and it is never a clock anchor.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-geotag_writes_o.title: Geotag's plan, execution and finalize leave prep's part of the database exactly as it was, and merge's untouched.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-gps_derived_off.title: An offset found from the camera's own GPS stays the camera's offset for the day once those photos are corrected, so a later photo without GPS needs no answer.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-manual_offset_i.title: test manual offset is not applied twice

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-new_photo_joins.title: Same camera, same day: the earlier answer — offset and drift confirmation — is kept through a run where every photo was already corrected, and applied to the new photo alone.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-originals_are_p.title: test originals are pinned once and complete

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-own_gps_camera_.title: With their own values pinned, a GPS camera's photos give the offset again on a re-run, as on the first: nothing is kept from earlier, and nothing is written.
A camera with its own GPS has its time corrected from that GPS, keeps the position, and is marked time-fixed; the re-run then neither corrects it again nor uses it as an anchor.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-the_log_keeps_e.title: Finalize logs what every executed pass did, in order and matched by fingerprint — not only the latest plan's operations: a photo corrected, then corrected again, then left alone shows all three.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-the_record_foll.title: Where every photo is marked and none has its own values pinned, the kept answer is derived from the decision, so the record never shows an effective value the decision no longer says.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-unlocated_geota.title: A file geotag once placed, now off the track and accepted as unlocated, loses geotag's old fix: kept, it would read as the file's own next time.

TST-geotag_rerun_markers-withdrawn_offse.title: test withdrawn offset after execute asks again

TST-geotag_resolved_utc-a_phone_time_tak.title: test a phone time takes the offset recorded with it[EXIF:DateTimeOriginal-OffsetTimeOriginal]

TST-geotag_resolved_utc-a_photos_scope_n.title: test a photos scope names the cell its offset came from

TST-geotag_resolved_utc-unrelated_config.title: §22.1 / shared §4.2: a config edit OUTSIDE the time-policy subset re-plans but must NOT restale already-resolved UTC. The resolved-UTC cache fingerprint is built from time-relevant inputs only (photos-21 sha, the camera-time-policy fingerprint, GPX, prep cache, field-set/key versions) — not a whole-config hash. Here we edit `merge.library_root` (a merge-phase key, untouched by geotag) and re-run: photos-21 stays byte-identical and the resolved_utc_cache_fingerprint is unchanged.

TST-geotag_time_decisions-a_file_naming_.title: test a file naming no camera is solved alone never asked

TST-geotag_time_decisions-bad_timezone_b.title: test bad timezone blocks and leaves artifact

TST-geotag_time_decisions-classifying_a_.title: test classifying a camera again restales the time decisions

TST-geotag_time_decisions-new_destinatio.title: Media added to a new destination asks for that destination's decisions alone; every settled decision elsewhere stays as the user left it.

TST-geotag_time_decisions-rerun_after_su.title: A successful execution and a finalize leave geotag re-runnable; only merge's seal stops it.

TST-geotag_time_decisions-rerun_preserve.title: test rerun preserves decisions and completes

TST-geotag_time_decisions-timezone_propo.title: A destination's timezone proposal prefers the nearest RESOLVED ancestor's timezone over the generic global default; an inherited (or config-default) proposal auto-resolves without per- destination confirmation (nested geography), staying overridable.

TST-guards_quarantine-a_folder_not_empty.title: A planned removal finding its folder not empty leaves it, skipped in the journal and reported; the run still succeeds.

TST-guards_quarantine-a_hidden_top_level.title: Once the workspace is initialized, an empty hidden folder at the top level is the user's: no plan removes it.

TST-guards_quarantine-band_guard_blocks_.title: test band guard blocks raw under video band
test band guard blocks video under photo band

TST-guards_quarantine-folders_left_empty.title: The folders a plan leaves empty — emptied by its moves, or empty already — are planned removals, deepest first, journaled as they run; a folder holding a file the plan leaves is not.

TST-guards_quarantine-prune_by_age_reads.title: A run's age is the time in its plan id; --plan-id and --older-than-days together select the runs either names.

TST-guards_quarantine-prune_dry_run_dele.title: test prune dry run deletes nothing

TST-guards_quarantine-prune_yes_with_pla.title: test prune yes with plan id deletes only that

TST-guards_quarantine-prune_yes_without_.title: test prune yes without selector or all refuses

TST-handoff-conflict_attributed_to_by_de.title: test conflict attributed to by dest folder

TST-handoff-grouping_facts_identity_and_.title: test grouping facts identity and device class

TST-handoff-handoff_content_fingerprint_.title: The content fingerprint is byte-stable across no-op reruns: it excludes run_metadata, diagnostics, the execution-journal pointer, itself, and the NESTED per-run audit (cache_freshness counts in camera_groups/destination_folders, and conflicts_or_duplicates); only real content moves it.
End-to-end (§16.2): a second prep run that changes nothing organized produces the SAME handoff content_fingerprint, even though run_metadata + cache-freshness counts differ run to run.

TST-handoff-unknown_device_class_when_no.title: test unknown device class when not configured

TST-idempotency_cache-chronological_dest.title: §11.2 (anti): a 0-sources file whose computed chronological destination in 5-photos-by-date collides with an EXISTING path must not clobber. setup_workspace seeds 5-photos-by-date/2023-01-01/2023-01-01--12-00-00.jpg = "already_date" and a 0-sources file (new_img, "new_source") that resolves to the same date/name. Prep must (a) plan a move_no_clobber to a suffixed name, never the occupied target, and (b) on execute, land the incoming under the safe -001 name while the colliding original stays byte-unchanged.

TST-idempotency_cache-execute_applies_on.title: §4 (anti): execute applies ONLY the recorded plan operations; it never re-derives the organization from the filesystem. Drop the new_img move op from the saved plan before executing: if execute re-derived it would still move new_img to 2-missing-metadata. Instead new_img stays EXACTLY where it is (0-sources, untouched), while the operations that REMAIN in the plan (the dup_img quarantine) still apply — proving execute is plan-driven, not a fresh derivation.

TST-idempotency_cache-no_special_reimpor.title: 2-missing-metadata is a holding bay, not a re-entry point: prep never reprocesses a file sitting there in place. A file still missing a date stays put (no op); the way to re-import is to move it to 0-sources, where it routes like any ordinary dump — here, to 5-photos-by-date by its (now present) date. No 2-missing-metadata-specific rescue path.

TST-idempotency_cache-quarantine_manifes.title: §14.3: the manifest evidence entry for a quarantined file is written BEFORE the file is moved into quarantine, so a crash never strands a file in quarantine with no record of why. Probe by wrapping both _append_quarantine_manifest and the move primitive _move_no_clobber to log a label in call order; setup_workspace's dup_img is the quarantined file. Assert the manifest append for the run precedes the quarantine move.

TST-idempotency_cache-quarantine_subtree.title: §15: the quarantine directory is excluded from the scan, so a rerun neither re-organizes nor re-quarantines its contents. A media file sitting under .photos-ingest-quarantine/<id>/ is never inventoried: no operation references it and it never enters the cache, while a real 0-sources photo is organized normally.

TST-idempotency_cache-restored_quarantin.title: No un-quarantine path: a file dragged back out of quarantine into 0-sources is re-evaluated as an ordinary fresh dump under a NEW plan_id — there is no special 'restore' handling that skips dedup. Here the restored file is still a duplicate of a by-dest photo, so it is quarantined AGAIN.

TST-lifecycle-a_folder_left_in_the_inbox.title: A prepped workspace whose inbox holds only an empty folder is not "nothing to do": geotag counts any entry there, so prep plans the folder's removal and its execution carries it out, leaving the inbox empty.

TST-lifecycle-a_log_the_handoff_does_not.title: A prepped workspace whose log is not the one its handoff records — a crash between the two writes — is not "nothing to do": prep runs its execution again, which rewrites both.

TST-lifecycle-a_prep_only_workspace_has_.title: Prepped and never geotagged, the workspace still holds a whole record of prep: every photo's journey keyed by its fingerprint, ending where the photo now is, with prep's database snapshot beside it — and nothing of geotag's or merge's is needed for it.

TST-lifecycle-by_dest_reprep_pending_hel.title: test by dest reprep pending helper

TST-lifecycle-named_pipe_at_root_blocks_.title: A top-level entry of any other kind — a named pipe — is misplaced like a file or a folder.

TST-lifecycle-new_dump_after_successful_.title: A dump arriving after geotag executed and finalized is prep's again: the loop resumes from prep.

TST-lifecycle-renamed_folders_found_by_r.title: The user names the managed folders; prep finds each by its role. With the inbox and the photos band renamed in the seed defaults, init builds the renamed folders and organizes into them — no default name is created or written into.

TST-merge_execute-a_copy_damaged_where_t.title: The content fingerprint reads the decoded image, blind to metadata by design. TST-merge_execute-a_folder_dropped_into_.title: A dump copied in as a whole folder lands at the top level: every command refusing the sealed workspace says a new dump is likely there, and leaves the folder exactly as it was.

TST-merge_execute-a_hidden_file_alone_is.title: A hidden file at the top level, such as one a file browser leaves, is not a dump: no command refusing the sealed workspace warns of one.

TST-merge_execute-a_photo_already_presen.title: A photo planned as already present whose workspace copy is gone counts as done only while the library still holds it.

TST-merge_execute-a_photo_gone_from_the_.title: test a photo gone from the workspace that no merge moved blocks the plan

TST-merge_execute-a_photo_moved_earlier_.title: test a photo moved earlier but gone from its place blocks the re plan

TST-merge_execute-a_re_plan_after_a_part.title: A partial merge — a.jpg moved, b.jpg blocked — is re-planned once the blocker is cleared. The new plan carries a.jpg forward from the plan that moved it, and the merge that finishes logs both.

TST-merge_execute-a_re_plan_carries_a_ph.title: A move that finished without its journal entry — a crash just after it, or a Ctrl-C while it ran — is carried by the re-plan on the evidence: its earlier plan's place, fingerprinted again, holds it.

TST-merge_execute-a_resumed_execute_chec.title: The journal says a.jpg was moved; its library place no longer holds it. Execute run again blocks it rather than counting it done, and the workspace is not sealed.

TST-merge_execute-config_is_byte_identic.title: Merge never writes the workspace config (photos-00-config.json is hand-edited, authoritative). Snapshot its bytes, run the full plan -> dry-run -> execute cycle, assert byte-for-byte identical.

TST-merge_execute-execute_already_presen.title: test execute already present removes source no write

TST-merge_execute-execute_cross_fs_move_.title: test execute cross fs move verifies and completes

TST-merge_execute-execute_jobs_identical.title: Beyond the summary, the placed LIBRARY file tree is byte-identical under -j1 vs -j4 — the move pass has no concurrency-dependent semantics (relative paths + bytes match exactly).

TST-merge_execute-execute_occupied_by_di.title: TOCTOU clobber guard: target FREE at plan (placed_new), then a *different-content* file appears at the planned target before execute. The execute-time recheck must refuse — rc 3, source left in by-dest, the irreplaceable library byte UNCHANGED. (The identical-content sibling is covered above by ...renamed/already-present; this dangerous different-content path was previously unexercised.)

TST-merge_execute-execute_placed_new_mov.title: test execute placed new moves into library

TST-merge_execute-execute_renamed_incomi.title: test execute renamed incoming places under safe name

TST-merge_execute-execute_required_snaps.title: snapshots_required + the library pre-mutation snapshot fails -> abort BEFORE any move: status rejected (rc 2), nothing placed, source untouched in by-dest, library empty, workspace NOT sealed. The required-snapshot guard is the merge spec §10.3-step-3 promise.

TST-merge_execute-execute_resume_after_c.title: test execute resume after crash before seal

TST-merge_execute-execute_resume_finishe.title: test execute resume finishes crash window

TST-merge_execute-execute_sweeps_crash_o.title: A prior interrupted run can leave a cross-fs copy temp (.tmp-xdev-*.part) in a library dir. Because merge holds the library lock (no concurrent merge), execute safely sweeps such orphans from the dirs it targets before placing — they never accumulate in the precious library tree.

TST-merge_execute-execute_torn_copy_bloc.title: test execute torn copy blocks and keeps source

TST-merge_execute-failed_placement_is_do.title: A placement that failed is never recorded as done: once its cause is gone, running execute again places the photo and the run succeeds.

TST-merge_execute-full_success_writes_te.title: test full success writes terminal artifacts and seals

TST-merge_execute-library_lock_held_thro.title: §10.4: the library lock is held for the WHOLE concurrent move pass — concurrency never relaxes cross-run exclusion. Probe by wrapping _move_file (the per-file placement that runs during the parallel pass): on its first invocation, a fresh LibraryLock on the same library_root must FAIL to acquire (rc False) because the running merge already holds it. Then call through to the original.

TST-merge_execute-library_takes_a_second.title: Merge ends its workspace — sealed, it refuses to merge again — and more media reaches the same library through a fresh workspace.

TST-merge_execute-merge_creates_in_the_l.title: Beyond its mark and its lock, a merge leaves in the library only the photos it placed and the folders they went into — no record, cache, temporary copy or database of its own.

TST-merge_execute-merge_journal_writes_o.title: Single-writer journal (§8.3): under -j4 the merge confirmation journal is persisted ONLY by the main thread; worker threads move files but never touch the journal. Probe every journal write.

TST-merge_execute-merge_only_inspects_sp.title: §15.1 (anti): merge never rescans the library wholesale — it fingerprints only each incoming file's specific collision target, never a library-wide index. Seed the library with the collision target PLUS unrelated files (same dir and another dir); probe the fingerprint seam and assert the unrelated files are NEVER fingerprinted, only the exact target the incoming would land on.

TST-merge_execute-merge_reads_the_librar.title: Merge lists only the folders its photos go to — and the library's top folder, for temporary copies a crash of its own left — never walks the library, and fingerprints a library file only where an incoming photo's place is taken.

TST-merge_execute-merge_snapshots_the_wo.title: Merge snapshots the workspace — it removes what it places from there — and the library beside it where the library can be snapshotted; a library that cannot be only narrows the snapshot, with a warning, and the merge proceeds.

TST-merge_execute-merge_takes_no_snapsho.title: Without the workspace's snapshot, merge takes none of the library either — rolled back alone it would lose the photos merge removed from the workspace. Not required, the merge warns that it has no rollback point, and proceeds.

TST-merge_execute-merge_writes_only_its_.title: Merge writes the library-file fingerprint cache and nothing else of the database: prep's and geotag's rows stand exactly as they were.

TST-merge_execute-one_database_in_the_wo.title: After a whole merge the workspace holds one database of record, besides the phase images and prep's scratch memo, and the library holds no database at all.

TST-merge_execute-partial_run_does_not_s.title: test partial run does not seal or finalize

TST-merge_execute-plan_blocks_when_bydes.title: Prep-consistency (precondition 4): a photo physically under 6-photos-by-dest but NOT in the finalized record (handoff predates the latest move into by-dest) -> 're-run prep' blocker at plan, rc 2, NO plan artifact written, nothing placed. Guards against merging an unrecorded file.

TST-merge_execute-precondition_failure_w.title: A preflight blocker stops merge before execute: no photos-31 summary, library byte-unchanged. Here the prep handoff is missing — a precondition the preflight gathers and refuses on.

TST-merge_execute-re_plan_after_failed_i.title: test re plan after failed is allowed

TST-merge_execute-reseal_archives_the_co.title: Merge's re-seal makes the package again: the whole control directory, merge's own records among it, listed in photos-35's manifest and archived with it.

TST-merge_execute-snapshot_and_revalidat.title: Sequencing (§10.3): the move-set is fixed BEFORE any concurrent placement — dependency revalidation and the pre-mutation snapshot both complete before the FIRST per-file move runs, even under -j4. Probe the call order via wrappers.

TST-merge_execute-the_library_file_is_re.title: The cache trusts size and modification time; removing the workspace's copy cannot be undone. A library file changed since the plan without either moving is still caught: the photo stays.

TST-merge_execute-the_run_reports_what_i.title: A partial run tells what it placed, what was already there, and each photo that stayed with its reason, and that nothing is sealed; the run that finishes tells that the workspace is sealed.

TST-merge_execute-the_summary_says_where.title: Each entry of the summary: where the photo landed, renamed or already present, removed from the workspace — or, blocked, no place in the library and the reason.

TST-merge_plan-a_case_variant_in_the_lib.title: A library file whose name differs from the target's only in case takes the place on a case-insensitive library and may be the same photo on any: it is fingerprinted like a file at the target itself — the same content already present there, different content renamed around.

TST-merge_plan-a_log_edited_after_finali.title: Each log carries the one before it unchanged and only adds: an entry of prep's that photos-26 no longer carries whole — either edited after finalize — blocks merge; one carried whole does not.

TST-merge_plan-a_plan_made_by_other_code.title: Merge's plan records the code that made it; dry run and execute refuse one made by another build, or recording none, before any change.

TST-merge_plan-a_plan_made_under_another.title: A merge plan records the ImageMagick it was made under; under another, its fingerprint comparisons no longer hold, and it is stale.

TST-merge_plan-another_imagemagick_has_p.title: Under an ImageMagick other than prep's, merge takes each photo's fingerprint again: one that still matches prep's is merged as ever — here found already in the library — and one that does not is blocked, left in by-dest, rather than called a different photo and placed again beside itself.

TST-merge_plan-any_config_edit_restales_.title: test any config edit restales the merge plan

TST-merge_plan-dry_run_summarizes_valida.title: test dry run summarizes validated plan

TST-merge_plan-dry_run_without_plan_erro.title: test dry run without plan errors

TST-merge_plan-enumerate_joins_prerename.title: test enumerate joins prerename handoff to final name

TST-merge_plan-merge_plan_records_folder.title: test merge plan records folder and extension fingerprints

TST-merge_plan-plan_renamed_incoming_app.title: test plan renamed incoming append at max plus one

TST-merge_plan-plan_two_incoming_case_va.title: Case-insensitive no-clobber (§7.2): two incoming photos whose final names differ ONLY in case target the same (empty) library dir. On a case-insensitive library they would collide; the plan resolves it now — one placed_new, the other suffix-renamed — instead of letting the second surface as an EEXIST blocker at execute.

TST-merge_plan-plan_unfingerprintable_li.title: test plan unfingerprintable library file blocks item

TST-merge_plan-replan_reports_library_fi.title: A re-plan says how many library fingerprints it took from the cache — and the plan it writes is the same file, the count kept out of it.

TST-merge_plan-the_library_mirrors_the_d.title: Each photo goes to the same path under the library as under photos by destination — nested folders as the user built them, the name geotag gave it, or its own where geotag renamed nothing.

TST-merge_preflight-a_library_holding_th.title: A library_root that holds the workspace is caught in the merge data path (validate_merge_config) and surfaces as a preflight blocker: rc 2, no plan, no photos-31 summary, no placement.

TST-merge_preflight-a_prep_log_the_hando.title: Prep's log touched after finalize — edited, removed, or a handoff recording no hash of it — stops merge, as it stops finalize: photos-26 can no longer be shown to carry prep's record.

TST-merge_preflight-every_misplaced_root.title: Any other top-level entry blocks, whatever its kind — a named pipe too — and the block names every one, not only the first.

TST-merge_preflight-filename_format_othe.title: test filename format other than prep s blocks

TST-merge_preflight-init_library_in_work.title: test init library in workspace with path blesses and writes config

TST-merge_preflight-init_library_reads_t.title: init-library reads the workspace's configuration whole and checked, as every command does: a setting cartographer does not know stops it before it blesses or writes anything.

TST-merge_preflight-init_library_refuses.title: test init library refuses a library holding the workspace
test init library refuses to record a library in a sealed workspace

TST-merge_preflight-init_library_without.title: test init library without path refuses a locked workspace

TST-merge_preflight-lock_contention_cove.title: The whole-run lock covers EXECUTE, not only plan: with the workspace lock held by another run, `execute` fails fast (rc 1) and writes no summary / places nothing.

TST-merge_preflight-locked_workflow_acqu.title: test locked workflow acquires both and releases

TST-merge_preflight-locked_workflow_exit.title: test locked workflow exits 1 if library locked
test locked workflow exits 2 on blocker

TST-merge_preflight-merge_never_repairs_.title: test merge never repairs a missing folder

TST-merge_preflight-no_finalized_media_r.title: test no finalized media record blocks

TST-merge_preflight-photo_changed_since_.title: test photo changed since finalize blocks

TST-merge_preflight-residual_folders_do_.title: Geotag's gates leave out the videos, the files missing metadata, the redundant JPEGs and the strays; what sits there blocks merge no more than it blocks geotag.

TST-merge_preflight-root_hidden_file_all.title: A hidden file at the top level (a file manager's `.directory`) is a hidden entry, not a misplaced dump: it blocks nothing (shared contract §4).

TST-merge_preflight-sealed_blocks_and_wa.title: test sealed blocks and warns on dump

TST-merge_preflight-sealed_new_dump_left.title: The merge sealed-workspace path warns about a new dump but relocates nothing: the dumped file stays byte-identical in 0-sources and the library is untouched (only its marker).

TST-merge_primitives-a_library_holding_t.title: test a library holding the workspace is refused[parent]

TST-merge_primitives-a_library_row_is_re.title: A cached library fingerprint is reused only when taken by this build's photo method under the current, known ImageMagick; otherwise the file is read again.

TST-move_aware-a_stale_row_follows_the_m.title: A moved file whose row would have been read again at its old path — its fingerprint taken by another ImageMagick, or its metadata read another way — is still recognized as moved, and read whole at its new path, the reason named; the old row is pruned.

TST-move_aware-ambiguous_match_is_rescan.title: test ambiguous match is rescanned not carried

TST-move_aware-by_date_to_by_dest_move_i.title: test by date to by dest move is recognized
